jobs.title: Operations Manager-CA
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**

Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.

Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill

Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

  
**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

 **Education**

High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$23.45 - $37.45

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

  
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/02/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

* Investigative and able to thrive in a dynamic, problem-solving environment
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills, able to build relationships and work with all levels of staff, including C-Suite

* This is a FLSA non-exempt position.
* This is not an OSHA high-risk position.
This is a Full Time position.

jobs.title: Loan Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
**Loan Operations Supervisor**

Bank of the Orient is an independent Asian Community Bank that has proudly served the financial needs of multiple Bay Area communities for over 55 years and Texas. We are well known for our commitment to providing the highest level of personal service to our customers; we take a personal interest in our communities' unique banking needs, we are dedicated to providing integrity in banking and financial services, we provide high quality dependable service by being accessible and reliable. We are committed to excellence in everything we do.

We have openings for full-time Loan Operations Supervisor for our Loan Servicing Team. Under general supervision and within established policies and procedures performs a wide variety of duties supervising the servicing and operations of loans including: preparation of demands; processing payoffs; release of liens; booking new loans and renewals; posting payments and loan disbursements; completion of credit ratings; tracking, problem resolution; maintenance of loan/customer information; security of Bank retained collateral; tracking of financial statements; and other time-sensitive processes/documents; as needed, produces correspondence; responds to customer inquiries; and supervises the workload of the loan operations team.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

1. Demonstrates quality customer service principles with internal and external customers consistently.

2. Supervises the activities of loan operations by responding to inquiries, resolving problems, assisting with complex transactions and sensitive customer relations problems, explaining policies and procedures to customers.

3. Assists in administering policies and procedures utilized in the department to ensure that department meets all compliance requirements.

4. Reviews loan documentation after closing for accuracy and completeness, disbursement of funds, input of new loans into the system, processing of incoming payments, and processing of all changes to borrowers accounts.

5. Maintains accurate accounting records on loan accounts, including balancing to the general ledger, and ensures that taxes, insurance, premiums, etc. are paid in a timely manner.

6. Prepares and compiles figures, forms and correspondence necessary to process loan payoffs.

7. Ensures that insurance coverage is maintained on all loan collateral and ensures follow-up on insurance cancellations and renews loan files to determine adequate insurance coverage in force.

8. Monitors the storage of loan documents, ensuring that loan papers are properly protected and that an efficient file maintenance system is maintained.

9. Prepares accurate and timely demands, beneficiary statements, reconveyances, releases of liens, UCC filings, and credit ratings.

10. Tracks loan commitments and corresponding balances, and reconciles transactions against the general ledger.

11. Responds to customer inquiries by researching, analyzing, and resolving issues in a timely manner.

12. Reviews all appropriate loan reports and provides all necessary audit trails and information on the appropriate report, daily.

13. As loans require bank retention of collateral (stock, CD’s, etc.), ensures the security and maintenance of the collateral, including timely valuations, receipts, and releases.

14. Prepares loan documentation according to the appropriate policies and procedures and within the service indicators.

15. Closes all loans according to the appropriate guidelines and then boards completed loans to the appropriate system loan application, product set, and field criteria.

16. Assists the department managers in design, development, and implementation of department projects as they relate to loan documentation, loan conversions

17. Researches, analyzes and resolves complex customer service issues technical operation problems, and loan documentation questions as required.

18. Runs statistical reports to analyze the productivity standards and oversee customer files.

19. Coordinates work with loan officers and other bank personnel to satisfy customer needs and resolve customer inquiries.

20. Prepares operations and compliance reports in a timely and accurate manner as needed.

21. Manages daily activities of the Loan Operations Assistant assigning work, answering questions, solving problems, helping with complex transactions and sensitive customer relations problems, explaining policies and procedures to customers.

22. Manages employee performance by conducting performance evaluations and monitoring performance and productivity of staff.

23. Actively participates in required Bank training satisfactorily and on time – i.e., customer service training, compliance training such as BSA / AML Training, computer training, etc.

24. Maintains strict control and confidentiality over all non-public customer information in accordance with the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, all applicable state regulations and the Bank’s Customer Information Security Policy.

25. Abides by and ensures that the Bank’s Compliance Programs, as well as other compliance and security banking laws, rules and regulations standards are met and required compliance reports are accurately filed – i.e., AML, BSA, OFAC, USA Patriot Act, SAR, KYC, et. al.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:**

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

1. Requires minimum 2 years college level courses.

2. Minimum 5 years’ experience in loan documentation and servicing in a financial services industry.

3. Requires loan servicing experience with commercial and consumer real estate loans.

4. Requires computer experience with programs such as MS Word, Excel, Laser Pro etc.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

1. Knowledge of basic accounting principles and techniques.

2. Demonstrated ability to read and analyze financial data.

3. Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.

4. Ability to multitask and handle large volumes of work.

jobs.title: Clinic Operations Manager - Hayward
jobs.description:
**JOB TYPE**

Temp to Perm (3 months - conversion based on performance and business need)

**JOB MISSION**

The mission of the Clinic Operations Manager at ACES is to elevate the standards in the treatment of Autism by providing administrative support to ACES’ clinical staff.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The role supports clinic operations through strategic scheduling, staff coordination, and client engagement to ensure optimal service delivery and prescription fulfillment. It involves managing Behavior Interventionist (BI) onboarding, performance, and satisfaction, while collaborating with HR and Clinical Directors to address staffing needs and retention. Additionally, the position oversees front desk duties, facility maintenance, and promotes center events to enhance client experience and operational efficiency.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

Working under the Clinical Director, essential job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* **Scheduling Support**

  + Follow established scheduling protocols and software use to manage session cancellations and rescheduling for in center clients
  + Collaborate with Clinical Directors regularly to meet prescription fulfillment
  + Coordinate assessment scheduling between assessors and new clients
* **BI Support and Management**

  + Collaborate with HR on BI-related needs (e.g., payroll, additional supports) and provide strategic input on hiring by assessing client staffing needs; participate in interviewing potential BI candidates
  + Support BI onboarding and integration by coordinating welcome activities, tech setup (iPads, I-9s, badges), and addressing early concerns in collaboration with onboarding team; serve as a positive first point of contact for new staff.
  + Monitor BI performance and satisfaction, providing feedback and disciplinary action for non-clinical conduct (e.g., communication, dress code, attendance, clinic policies); escalate concerns or retention risks to the Clinical Director as needed
  + Oversee the BI annual review process by ensuring accurate collection and reporting of clinical and non-clinical scorecard data in alignment with organizational standards
  + Provide oversight of RBT credentialing, including initial steps, actions to maintain certification, renewal processes, and ensuring compliance with 5% BCBA supervision requirements
* **Client Supports**

  + Serve as a positive contact for in center clients and caregivers
  + Collaborate with caregivers to identify opportunities for make-up sessions or extending service hours to maximize prescription fulfillment
* **Center Needs**

  + Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant clinic environment by monitoring staff presentation, coordinating supply and custodial needs, and communicating facility-related requests (e.g., repairs, materials, furniture) to appropriate teams to ensure a safe and functional workspace.
  + Oversee daily clinic operations, including opening and closing procedures; coordinate Manager on Duty coverage in collaboration with office leadership
  + Monitor center space utilization and coordinate scheduling of physical therapy sessions and assessments to maximize efficiency and meet client needs
  + Conduct in-center tours for prospective clients, highlighting the clinic’s physical space and clinical excellence.
  + Manage front desk responsibilities including greeting staff and caregivers, answering phones, relaying messages, and ensuring proper sign-in/out procedures.
  + Manage incoming mail and packages, ensuring timely distribution and handling in accordance with center protocols
  + Promote center events by posting announcements and sending reminders to increase attendance and engagement.

The foregoing job responsibilities are illustrative only and are not meant to be exhaustive. ACES reserves the right to change, amend or modify the job description/responsibilities at any time and in its sole discretion.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum of a high school diploma
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in a professional office environment
* Previous experience in a front desk or administrative support role
* Strong background in customer service; experience in client-facing roles preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant software, including email, internet applications, databases, and project management tools
* Exceptional organizational, time management, and multitasking skills
* Maintains a professional demeanor, positive attitude, and polished appearance
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to adhere to strict protocols and maintain compliance with HIPAA regulations
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with daily deadlines
* Receptive to feedback and adaptable to changing priorities

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force and lift/move up to 15 pounds
* Ability to sit for long periods of time (up to 3 hours at a time) during the scheduled workday

**Additional Information**

*ACES is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, disability, age or covered veteran status.*

jobs.title: Foodservice Operations & Development Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Location**: Greater Bay Area, CA | 75% Travel 25% in Office
  
**FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act):** Exempt
  
**Reporting Structure:** Director of Fresh Food
  
**Salary Range**: $110,000-$140,000 Annual

**Join Our Growing Team!**
  
Vintners Distributors is the corporate arm that oversees West Coast Convenience, Eaton Foods, Eatswell, and Prohas Enterprises. Its portfolio includes Loop Neighborhood Market, Poppy Market, select Chevron locations, Krispy Krunchy Chicken, and other quick-service restaurant brands. Headquartered in Union City, CA, the company operates a growing network of convenience stores, fuel stations, and car washes across California. Founded in 1978, it also develops real estate and owns and operates its locations.

Vintners Distributors continues to expand and seek customer-focused individuals who want to make an impact. We are committed to delivering high-quality, better-for-you products and an exceptional store experience, guided by our core values: People, Teamwork, Communication, Training, Results Matter, Fun, Customer-Centered, and Safety.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are driven by service, innovation, and teamwork, we invite you to join us in redefining convenience for our customers every day.

**Position Summary**

The Foodservice Operations & Development Manager will play a key role in shaping and growing our foodservice business, helping develop our own branded restaurant concepts and bringing new ideas to life—from concept planning and pilot testing to opening day and ongoing operations. Working directly with the Director of Fresh Food, this hands-on leader will help design, launch, and expand distinctive foodservice experiences across our growing network.

This position is responsible for leading operations across multiple foodservice and restaurant locations, developing strong teams, and delivering results in sales, profitability, food quality, food safety, and guest experience. The manager will also help build the operating foundation for continued growth, translating new concepts into practical workflows, effective training, clear SOPs, and consistent execution.

This is an opportunity for an experienced multi-unit foodservice leader who enjoys building something new, developing people, and taking ownership of both successful launches and day-to-day performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Partner with the Director of Fresh Food to develop and launch company-owned restaurant concepts, including concept planning, menu execution, kitchen layouts, equipment selection, operating workflows, pilot testing, and opening readiness.

* Lead and oversee daily operations for multiple foodservice and restaurant locations across greater California.
* Drive consistent execution of the company's Fast, Friendly, and clean service standards at every location.
* Recruit, hire, onboard, train, coach, and develop restaurant managers and team members.
* Conduct regular location visits, operational audits, and performance reviews to ensure compliance with company standards.
* Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve practical restaurant SOPs, training materials, checklists, operating routines, and accountability tools.
* Establish clear procedures for opening and closing, shift management, food preparation, production planning, food safety, sanitation, inventory, ordering, waste control, equipment care, and guest service.
* Apply proven QSR practices to build scalable systems that are easy to teach, measure, and execute across multiple restaurant concepts and locations.
* Test procedures in the field, gather team feedback, and revise standards to improve consistency, efficiency, food quality, and profitability.
* Ensure consistent execution of food quality, food safety, sanitation, merchandising, speed of service, hospitality, and customer service expectations.
* Monitor sales, labor, food cost, inventory, waste, and profitability metrics and implement action plans to improve performance.
* Support new restaurant openings, remodels, menu and program rollouts, equipment installations, and operational initiatives.
* Partner with Operations, Human Resources, Training, Marketing, Facilities, IT, and Foodservice leadership to improve processes and team performance.
* Build bench strength and succession plans for restaurant leadership positions within the district.
* Coach teams on guest recovery, hospitality, upselling, labor deployment, production planning, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, federal, and company food safety, sanitation, employment, and labor requirements.
* Build a culture of accountability, teamwork, urgency, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Respond quickly and effectively to operational issues, staffing challenges, equipment problems, food safety concerns, and guest complaints.
* Communicate field needs, risks, opportunities, and performance results clearly to the Director of Fresh Food and other company leaders.

**Requirements:**

Experience opening new restaurant locations, launching foodservice concepts or programs, and translating ideas into successful daily operations strongly preferred.

* 5+ years of progressive multi-unit leadership experience in quick-service restaurants, fast-casual restaurants, or comparable high-volume foodservice operations required.
* Previous experience as a District Manager, Area Manager, Multi-Unit Manager, Director of Operations, or similar restaurant leadership position required.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Optivolt**
------------------

Optivolt’s mission is to overshoot humanity’s energy supply by reimagining solar.

America is at an inflection point. We need reliable energy fast. The grid is aging. And solar, the only technology that deploys quickly enough, is still constrained by technology frozen in time.

To close this gap, we build intelligent solar systems that think and adapt to real world conditions. Optivolt solar systems understand the sun, the weather, shading, harsh conditions, and optimize energy flow in real time. Every Optivolt panel is designed with an aerospace power electronics brain sealed inside to make solar more powerful and cost effective than ever in any condition.

The next step is putting it everywhere. In the home as Optivolt Home Solar and in the field as Optivolt Solar Fields. Hyper performant, controllable, reliable solar that works for everyone, everywhere.

**Our Team & Traction**
-----------------------

Optivolt is a team of some of the best builders and doers in the world, drawing from incredible talent pools in aerospace, electrical engineering, design-led organizations. We ultimately will win by designing and building the world’s best solar energy products.

But chiefly important, our organization is a lab for those devoted to solving some of the toughest problems in energy. Everyone is expected to contribute to the mission meaningfully. Clear communication, rapid iteration, and strong work ethic is the floor for anyone on our team.

To date we’ve shipped over 20,000 units and have companies worth billions of dollars relying on our solar architecture.

**Why we are looking for you**
------------------------------

As Operations Manager, you will own the business processes and day-to-day operations that support our growth. You’ll manage working capital, financial projections, accounting workflows, and business systems while keeping logistics and facilities running reliably.

This hands-on role combines business operations with responsibility for our physical workplace and supply flow. You will partner with leadership, engineering, accounting providers, and legal counsel on budgets, forecasts, contracts, and practical processes. You’ll also directly manage shipping, inventory, vendors, and facility needs.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **1. Business Operations and Financial Planning**

* Manage working capital across receivables, payables, inventory, and supplier commitments; improve collections, payment terms, and cash conversion.
* Build and maintain cash-flow forecasts, operating budgets, and revenue, expense, and inventory projections with leadership.
* Track actual results against plans, explain variances, and model purchasing, hiring, and growth scenarios to support decisions.
* Manage purchasing approvals and spending controls; identify cost reductions and flag cash needs and operational risks early.

### **2. Accounting and ERP Systems**

* Own AR/AP workflows, including quotes, customer invoicing, collections, vendor bills, and payment scheduling within approval processes.
* Handle routine bookkeeping and account reconciliations; support month-end close and financial reporting with accounting providers.
* Administer and improve ERP and accounting workflows across purchasing, inventory, billing, and reporting; maintain accurate records and access controls.
* Maintain financial and operational dashboards, SOPs, approvals, and supporting records for reliable reporting and audit readiness.

### **3. Contracts and Business Administration**

* Coordinate customer and vendor agreements, NDAs, and purchase terms from preparation through approval and signature.
* Negotiate commercial terms with leadership and coordinate legal review with counsel; track open issues through completion.
* Maintain contract, insurance, and corporate records; track renewals, obligations, and administrative deadlines.

### **4. Shipping Logistics and Inventory**

* Own domestic and international shipping and receiving for prototypes, equipment, production materials, and field deployments.
* Manage carriers, freight forwarders, rates, shipping and customs documentation, delivery tracking, and claims or exceptions.
* Maintain inventory accuracy through labeling, cycle counts, and ERP reconciliation; coordinate returns and RMAs with engineering and quality.

### **5. Facilities and Lab Operations**

* Keep office, lab, and testing spaces functional, organized, and safe, including maintenance, access, and basic safety supplies and records.
* Manage facility vendors, service contracts, budgets, upgrades, and equipment installations to support engineering and production needs.
* Provide hands-on support for deliveries, visitors, workspace changes, and indoor and outdoor test setups.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 3+ years in business operations, finance operations, or operations management, including 1+ years owning financial and operational processes.
* Hands-on experience managing working capital and preparing cash-flow forecasts, budgets, financial projections, and variance analyses.
* Working knowledge of bookkeeping, AR/AP, account reconciliations, and financial statements; experience supporting an accounting close.
* Experience administering or improving ERP and accounting systems across purchasing, inventory, and finance.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial models, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and scenario analysis.
* Experience coordinating contracts, negotiating commercial terms, and working with legal counsel or external advisors.
* Experience managing facilities, logistics, vendors, and physical inventory in a hardware, manufacturing, lab, or similar environment.
* Ability to prioritize independently, communicate financial and operational tradeoffs, and handle confidential information responsibly.
* Track record improving processes and controls while remaining willing to handle routine accounting,

jobs.title: Manager, Talent Acquisition Operations & Enablement
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

DigitalOcean is looking for a Recruiting Operations & Enablement Manager to own the systems, processes, and infrastructure that power our recruiting function. This is a hands-on role: you'll manage the day-to-day health of our recruiting tech stack, build the operational rigor that lets recruiting scale cleanly as the business grows, and partner closely with recruiters and People teams to remove friction from the hiring process.

You're equally comfortable setting operational strategy and getting into the weeds of an ATS workflow, a scheduling exception, or a messy report. You build things that hold up as the company scales including the documentation and data hygiene expected of a public company.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the strategy and day-to-day operation of our recruiting systems, including our ATS and scheduling/coordination tooling, ensuring they're configured, adopted, and running smoothly across the recruiting org.
* Build and document repeatable, scalable processes that hold up as headcount and hiring volume grow.
* Own data hygiene and reporting across recruiting systems: clean requisition data, accurate candidate and pipeline records, and dashboards recruiting and business leaders can trust.
* Partner with recruiters to identify the biggest sources of friction and manual work, then prioritize and build solutions — whether that's a new workflow, automation, or process redesign leveraging AI and tools.
* Evaluate and implement new recruiting technology and AI-enabled tools that make the team meaningfully more effective, and manage vendor relationships with a focus on ROI.
* Work as a close partner to People Operations, Legal and Finance on shared processes such as offer letter management, background checks, and headcount approvals, ensuring clean handoffs.
* Define success metrics for recruiting operations and use data to drive continuous improvement across the candidate and interviewer experience.
* Build and maintain processes with the rigor and auditability expected of a public company, anticipating compliance needs before they're required.

**What You'll Add to DigitalOcean**
-----------------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in recruiting operations, with hands-on experience in recruiting coordination, systems administration, and process design.
* 2+ years of experience managing people or leading cross-functional workstreams.
* Proven experience building and documenting processes that are repeatable and support data hygiene across recruiting systems.
* Strong command of ATS platforms (e.g., Greenhouse, Ashby, Workday) and recruiting/scheduling tools.
* A data-driven approach to program management, with experience building KPIs, dashboards, and translating insights into action.
* Comfortable experimenting with AI tools and automation (e.g., Zapier, scripts, AI-powered workflows) to reduce manual work.
* Excellent communication skills — able to earn buy-in and drive adoption across teams without relying on formal authority.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in a high-growth, publicly traded tech company, particularly with SOX-related process considerations.
* Familiarity with employer branding, referral programs, or other recruiting programs work.
* Experience partnering directly with People Operations on offer management and background checks.

**Compensation Range:**
-----------------------

* $120,000 - $150,000

* This is a remote role

JR: 2026-8311

*#LI-Remote*

**Why You'll Like Working for DigitalOcean**
--------------------------------------------

* **We innovate with purpose.** You'll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

**About the role**
------------------

Grüns is scaling fast, and our customer experience has to scale with it. As CX Operations Manager, you'll own the systems behind how our support team learns, performs, and improves: the knowledge base, training, QA, and the data that shows us where to act next. You'll partner with our BPO leadership and our AI Lead to make every agent sharper and every customer interaction faster and better.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a quarterly basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Own our knowledge base as the single source of truth: accurate, organized, easy to use, and audited on a recurring cadence
* Design and facilitate CX onboarding, training, and continuing education for new and tenured agents, including virtual sessions across time zones, built for every learning style
* Dig into CSAT, NPS, QA, FCR, and AHT data to find gaps in workflows and knowledge, then turn them into specific fixes
* Partner with our internal QA team and BPO leadership on calibrations, 1:1 coaching, and performance improvement plans, serving as the liaison between support leadership and agents
* Build and maintain FAQs and agent macros that drive self-service and agent efficiency
* Work with our AI Lead to identify automation and deflection opportunities, and implement internal tools that improve resolution times and CSAT

**We're looking for someone who:**
----------------------------------

* Has 5+ years in Customer Experience, Support Operations, CX Ops, QA, Training, or Knowledge Management
* Has 2+ years in a managerial role, or an equivalent independent-contributor role with real ownership
* Has worked directly with BPO teams
* Has created and maintained documentation (SOPs, macros, help articles, templates) that a frontline team actually uses
* Has mastered analyzing CX performance reporting: CSAT, quality scoring, contact drivers, first response time, and resolution quality
* Is hands-on with a support platform (Gladly, Zendesk, Gorgias, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar), a knowledge tool (Notion, Confluence, Guru, or similar), and QA workflows (scorecards, sampling, calibration)
* Is strong in Google Workspace and builds trackers and reporting in Sheets with ease (pivot tables, filters, structured logs)
* Bonus: has used AI tools or built AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code)

**Approach to the role:**
-------------------------

* Runs a regimented cadence: sets the rhythm, hits deadlines, and keeps programs moving without reminders
* Obsesses over clarity: writes things so anyone can execute them and removes ambiguity wherever it hides
* Thinks in patterns: spots repeat issues fast, tags them consistently, and turns them into fixes
* Balances customer-first with policy discipline: empathetic and flexible, but grounded in what we can promise and deliver
* Collaborates without creating drag: brings solutions, not noise
* Leads virtual training with a flexible schedule across time zones, and isn't afraid to take an escalation call when it counts
* Owns the outcome with extreme ownership, with no micromanagement needed and always ten steps ahead

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package—grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is between **$100,000 – $110,000 plus bonus** depending on experience.

Beyond base salary, we offer competitive equity packages and a comprehensive set of benefits designed to support the well-being, growth, and balance of our team.

**A bit about us...**

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There's an infinite number of "nutrition" companies, all focused on what's best for them — not what's best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We've seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

  

**What we care about...**

**Be the Best:** We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

**Own It:** We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

**Drive Impact, Urgently:** We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

  

**Compensation & Perks:**

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage - for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

**Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. You will serve as the bridge between marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and finance, so that every team works from the same numbers and the same definitions.

If you love building systems that scale, untangling messy data, and giving teams reports they can trust, this role is for you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Technology Stack Management**
-------------------------------

* **Platform Administration:** Own HubSpot as the marketing team’s system of record, including properties, workflows, lists, forms, email deliverability, user permissions, and governance standards.
* **Tool Integration:** Connect HubSpot and the wider marketing stack to Salesforce and other tools (website, webinar and event platforms, paid media channels, data enrichment), and monitor sync health so data moves reliably between systems.
* **Vendor Management:** Evaluate new software, run pilots, negotiate contracts and renewals with procurement and finance, and remove “shelfware” that team members don’t use.
* **Stack Roadmap:** Maintain a documented map of the marketing stack (owners, costs, renewal dates, integrations) and plan where it should go next, including AI and automation tools that help a lean team move faster.

**Data, Analytics & Attribution**
---------------------------------

* **Lead Scoring & Routing:** Build and maintain fit and engagement scoring models and routing logic so high-intent leads reach the right salespeople quickly, with clear follow-up SLAs across regions.

* **Account-Based Data:** Support account-based marketing by maintaining target account lists, account-level engagement scoring, and intent signals across HubSpot and Salesforce.

-----------------------------------

* **Campaign Operations:** Own campaign setup standards, including UTM conventions, naming taxonomy, HubSpot campaign objects, and Salesforce campaign hierarchy, so every program is tracked consistently from launch.
* **A/B Testing Frameworks:** Set up clean tracking for marketing experiments across email, landing pages, and paid media, with agreed success metrics and sample sizes, so teams can trust their test results.
* **Playbook Creation:** Document internal processes, from campaign launch checklists to lead management rules, so the marketing team can scale without losing efficiency.
* **Global Operations:** Build processes that work across regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC), including localized forms, regional consent requirements, and routing for international teams.

* **Funnel & Pipeline Reporting:** Build dashboards for marketing, sales leadership, and executives covering MQL volume, stage conversion rates, speed to lead, marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, and closed-won revenue.
* **Channel Reporting:** Track performance across paid media, email, website, social, events, and content, from spend and engagement to the leads and pipeline each channel produces.
* **Budget & ROI:** Partner with finance to track spend against budget and report on CAC, cost per MQL, cost per opportunity, and ROI by channel and campaign.
* **Planning & Enablement:** Support annual and quarterly planning with funnel math tied to pipeline targets, run weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting reviews, and train marketing and sales teams on HubSpot and reporting.

### **WHO YOU ARE**

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or marketing technology, ideally in B2B SaaS, data, or media.
* Expert-level HubSpot administration skills; HubSpot certifications are a plus.

**About the role**
------------------

As Revenue Operations Manager for Enterprise GTM, you will own the measurement layer of our go-to-market engine. You will be the key to what is in the pipeline, what is converting, what is slipping, and, most importantly, why, and the . Your primary customers are our enterprise new logo and expansion teams across healthcare and life sciences, financial and professional services, TMT and energy, and public sector.

We treat go-to-market as an engineered system. Architecture and design sit with the Director you report to. Instrumentation, measurement, and diagnosis sit with you.

This is an individual contributor role with a wide mandate and real exposure. You will not manage a team. You will own numbers that go to the VP of Enterprise GTM, the executive staff, and the board.

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Own the enterprise reporting layer**

* Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into pipeline health, stage conversion, sales velocity, coverage ratios, and attainment against plan, cut by vertical, segment, and rep.
* Establish a single agreed definition for every core metric (pipeline created, qualified pipeline, coverage multiple, win rate, cycle time, ACV, committed vs. consumed) and defend it. One number, one source, one definition.
* Report bookings, recognized revenue, and consumption as the distinct measures they are, and make the bridge between them legible to people who do not live in the model.
* Run the operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls in Salesforce and Clari, MBRs, QBRs, and the enterprise section of board reporting.
* Build stakeholder-specific, self-serve views so vertical leaders, sales development, and partnerships can answer their own routine questions without opening a ticket with you.

### **Turn the data into insight**

* Answer the hard "why" questions, e.g., why Stage 3 conversion dropped in financial services, which sourcing motions produce the highest-ACV enterprise deals, where multi-year agreements stall in legal review.
* Build leading indicators and early-warning triggers so leadership sees a coverage or velocity problem 60 days out rather than in the last week of the quarter.
* Pressure-test the forecast. Deliver an independent bottoms-up call and be willing to disagree with the field's number in front of senior leaders.
* Diagnose where to reallocate capacity, headcount, and pipeline generation effort across verticals, and bring the recommendation, not just the chart.
* Produce the analysis behind strategic bets: segmentation changes, territory restructuring, pricing and packaging shifts, new vertical entry.

### **Instrument the funnel and the systems that feed it**

* Own top-of-funnel reporting for Sales Development: lead conversion loops, sourced vs. influenced pipeline, meeting-to-opportunity rates, and adherence to the Sales Development Playbook.
* Champion CRM data integrity. Set and enforce completeness standards for qualification fields, next steps, close dates, and competitive tags. No insight survives a dirty pipeline.
* Work hands-on in the GTM stack: Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Clay.
* Partner with GTM Engineering to automate reporting and enrichment, and use AI aggressively to compress your own analysis cycle, e.g., signal-based enrichment, automated variance commentary, first-draft narratives for business reviews.

### **Support planning and compensation**

* Support the Director of Enterprise GTM Architecture through annual and quarterly planning: capacity modeling, territory design, headcount planning, and quota setting.
* Partner with Finance and Legal on the design and modeling of Enterprise and Sales Development commission plans, and own the reporting that tracks whether those plans are driving the intended behavior.

  

**Who you are**
---------------

* **8+ years** in revenue operations, sales operations, GTM strategy, or a highly quantitative business operations role at a high-growth B2B SaaS, PaaS, or AI infrastructure company. Time in management consulting, investment banking, or PE counts toward this when paired with in-house operating experience.
* **Analytically hands-on.** Deep Salesforce reporting fluency, strong command of at least one BI layer (Looker, Hex, Tableau, Sigma), and comfort writing SQL against a warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks). You build the analysis yourself.
* **Enterprise sales fluency.** You know pipeline coverage math cold, you have worked inside a stage-gate qualification framework such as MEDDIC, and you understand what actually moves a seven-figure, multi-threaded, multi-year deal.
* **A track record of reporting people use.** You have built dashboards that changed decisions, not dashboards that nobody opens. You can tell the difference and you optimize for the former.
* **Structured under ambiguity.** You can take a vague, badly-posed question, structure it from scratch, find the root cause, and build a system that keeps it from recurring.
* **Commercially and technically curious.** You will need to speak credibly about our AI products, our differentiators, and the objections enterprise buyers raise around deployment, security, and data.
* **Persuasive with executives.** You can challenge the field's forecast with data in a room of senior leaders and keep the relationship intact.
* **Genuinely interested in using AI to do this job better,** not just to report on selling it.

Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Sales leadership and the broader Revenue Operations team to design the systems, processes, and insights that power how our teams generate and manage pipeline.

From redesigning workflows and building reporting frameworks to improving how teams adopt new processes and systems, you’ll play a critical role in helping our Sales organization operate effectively at scale.

Join our team for the opportunity to work with esteemed business leaders on the front lines of the most transformative strategy and leadership work in the world.

We are seeking a talented Operations Manager to join our team in the San Francisco Bay Area. This role is deeply involved in client relationships while handling the logistics of consulting and coaching engagements, client offsites, and business development. You will support two Partners, a senior client-facing Partner and Trium's Founder & Chairman, and you will work directly with highly skilled consulting practitioners through the entire business development and delivery process of their work.

This is a particularly exciting time in Trium's history as we are celebrating more than 27 years of successful client engagements and thought leadership. If you are looking for a place where you can make a huge impact, where each member of the team is constantly bringing their A-game, and where you will be perpetually challenged to grow and evolve personally and professionally, The Trium Group is the place for you.

* 6-10 years' experience in executive administrative or project management roles
* Exposure to strategy, business development, and high-profile external stakeholders at the C-level
* A high level of emotional intelligence coupled with a detailed & analytical approach to your work
* Hyper-organization and conscientiousness with outstanding execution skills

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are hiring a Deal and Contract Operations Manager to join our Business Operations team in San Francisco. In this role, you will design and own the end-to-end deal and contracting processes mainly by supporting and training deal owners on contracting workflows, including operational ownership of our contracting tool, acting as the escalation point before deals get stuck, coordinating across internal approver teams such as Legal, Tax, and Finance to keep deals moving forward, and ensuring every signed partner has a smooth onboarding experience by involving the right stakeholders pre- and post-close.  
  
Because you sit at the center of every deal, you will have a unique vantage point to spot what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled across the deal lifecycle, and coordinate with the rest of the functions under Bizops (i.e. Sales Ops, Order Management, Business Systems etc.) to make it happen. You will use that perspective to build frameworks, drive process automation, and continuously reduce the time it takes to get from contract signing to customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams like Partner Success, Order Management, and Logistics are engaged at the right time.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and maintain the end-to-end contract operations processes, from template selection support through approval alongside Legal so that deal owners (i.e. Business Development and Partner Success teams) can move deals through the process efficiently and with minimal friction.
* Project-manage deals from contract signing through customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams (Partner Success, Order Management, RevOps, Logistics) are engaged at the right time prior to deal close, and that non-standard terms are highlighted and passed along to the correct stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot Contract Lifecycle Management (i.e.) workflow issues, advise on routing and approvals, and unblock bottlenecks so deal owners can keep momentum.
* Train and equip Business Development teams to be self-sufficient in the contracting process: how to create CLM workflows, select the right contract template and deal term configuration, route to the correct approvers, and anticipate approval requirements
* Ensure contract templates are properly created and maintained within the CLM system in adherence with the Amazon policy, and assist Business Development with escalating redlines to Legal and driving alignment on accepted terms.
* Use your centralized vantage point across all deals to spot patterns and identify what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled, translating those insights into process improvements that make the entire deal lifecycle faster and more consistent.
* Lead process automation initiatives with the goal of decreasing contract throughput time and increasing deal signing velocity.
* Develop lightweight tooling and streamlined processes for higher-frequency, lower-complexity deals (e.g., direct Enterprise deals), including enabling 3P sales reps to independently handle NDAs and select contracting workflows on our behalf.
* Develop AI-based mechanisms to handle specialized deals with exception approvals for non-standard requests.
* Collaborate closely with Sales Ops and Order Management to feed process automation ideas and ensure the right tooling gets built to reduce manual effort across the deal-to-onboarding lifecycle.
* Continuously improve the onboarding experience for B2B customers by removing avoidable friction points, with decreasing time-to-onboard as a key success metric.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning checking in on active deals in Contract Central, spotting one that's waiting on Tax approval and flagging to the BD owner how long that step usually takes. By midday, you could be helping a Business Development lead pick the right contract template and approval routing for a non-standard deal, or bringing Partner Success and Order Management in ahead of a signing so onboarding starts smoothly. Afternoons often involve working with Legal, Finance, and Sales Ops to clear a recurring bottleneck, followed by turning what you've seen across deals into a standard workflow or an automation idea. You will regularly train deal owners on contracting best practices and present recommendations to leaders on reducing time from signing to onboarding.  
  
About the team  
Our team keeps eero's partner deals and orders moving, from contract signing through delivery. As part of eero Business Operations, we work closely with Business Development, Partner Success, Legal, Finance, Order Management, and Logistics teams to build the processes and tools that help ISPs, Enterprise customers, and retail partners around the world get eero into their customers' homes and businesses. We value ownership, creative problem-solving, and using AI and automation to take manual work off our plates so we can focus on our partners. As we grow into new channels and regions, you will have the opportunity to shape how we scale deal and contract operations.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
* 3+ years of experience in operations or program management that is GTM and business team facing.
* Working familiarity with contracts approval tools, like Amazon’s Contract Central, or the like

jobs.title: Project Manager, Proteostasis Project
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**  
The Project Manager, Proteostasis Project, supports the Buck Institute's leadership of a multi-participant project focused on proteostasis. Reporting into Technology Transfer & Business Development, this role works closely with the Buck lead Principal Investigator and scientists to manage Buck's internal and external obligations under the agreements.  
  
The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating project reporting, identifying and reporting inventions, coordinating compliance, preparing meetings and presentations, and serving as the day-to-day liaison between Buck and Project Team Members. The role is scientist-facing and team oriented. It does not process payments or execute agreements; those functions remain with Finance, Grants and the Institute's authorized signatories, whom this position supports with documentation and tracking.  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Project Coordination and Reporting**

* Serve as the day-to-day administrative point of contact with the funding representative and the broader project team in coordination with the Buck PI and Business Development.
* Coordinate, consolidate and submit monthly technical and financial status reports, milestone and deliverable packages, the Project Plan and other documentation required under the agreement, in the format and by the deadlines the funder requires.
* Issue reporting and deliverable templates communicate deadlines and any changing requirements, and enforce internal deadlines.
* Proactively identify late, incomplete, or at-risk contributions and work with the responsible team member, collaborating institution, and project leadership to resolve issues.
* Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar of every obligation, deliverable, milestone and reporting deadline under all the agreements supporting the project from kickoff through close-out.
* Maintain the consolidated project file on behalf of the Buck and make it available to co-lead university collaborator.

**Meetings, Agendas and Presentations**

* Arrange agendas, briefing materials and presentations for team and funder encounters, including the program kickoff, monthly progress meetings, milestone reviews, annual PI review meetings and funder site visits.
* Work with the co-lead PIs and team member scientists to assemble clear, accurate slides and summaries of progress against program metrics and milestones.
* Organize internal team meetings, including co-lead PI governance meetings, Technical Advisory Board meetings and Translation Advisory Board meetings; record decisions and track action items to completion.
* Attend monthly funder meetings with the PI, and track the program's 90% annual meeting attendance requirement.
* Coordinate logistics for site visits and in-person reviews at Buck and, as needed, at co-lead’s location and other team member locations.

**Invention Identification and Reporting**

* Work with Buck scientists to recognize potentially patentable results early and route them to the Business Development team.
* Collect invention disclosures and other intellectual property information and prepare their disclosure to the funder.
* Track each team member’s election of title, and report as appropriate.
* Track joint inventions and assist with the negotiation, execution and maintenance of inter-institutional agreements.
* Coordinate periodic training for team scientists on prompt invention disclosure, as the OTA requires.

**Liaison with Team Members**

* Serve as Buck's counterpart to co-lead's program and contracts staff, and support governance, decision logs and escalations under the associate agreements.
* Serve as the working contact for PIs, grants officers and technology transfer offices for all team member institutions.
* Manage the funder direction protocol: when any team member receives direction affecting scope, schedule, budget or milestones, flag it so the team coordinates a response before acting.
* Coordinate preparation and track the status of all related agreement amendments and modifications, including option exercises, and route them to the Buck’s authorized signatories; confirm team member approval is in hand before any modification affecting them is signed.

**Compliance and Program Requirements**

* Collect annual certifications as required.
* Track IRB, IACUC, Federalwide Assurance and Animal Welfare Assurance status across team members, and coordinate the team's response to any suspension or adverse finding.
* Maintain the team's channel for reporting results of concern under the program's dangerous gain of function prohibitions, and ensure such results reach the funder promptly.
* Collect draft publications across the team and process as required by agreements.
* Flag export control and foreign participation issues, including proposed transfers of IP, data or materials to foreign entities, for review before they occur.
* Support the Translation Advisory Board and the revised commercialization plan with a named commercial partner.

Based in Richmond, we are a leading general contractor serving commercial, education, healthcare, life science, water, industrial, energy, and transportation markets. Overaa Construction is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to join our Building Group and lead the delivery of complex public and institutional building projects, including essential-service facilities such as police and fire stations, courthouses, correctional facilities, healthcare facilities, and other municipal buildings.

**Overall Responsibilities and Authority**

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end-to-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology-focused project management
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

jobs.title: Fire Systems Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Fire Systems Project Manager – Fire Alarm & Life Safety Construction (must have experience)**

**Immediate Employment**

  

* + Compensation from $130,000.00 - $150,000.00
  + Company Vehicle
  + Fuel Card & Fastrak

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Fire Systems Project Manager with experience in **fire alarm installation, life safety, and low voltage construction**. Our Project Managers (PM) are responsible for the execution of low voltage system projects in accordance with project budgets, code compliance, and managing the field operations team’s work quality and work output. This position will work closely with our sales team, installation team, and clients to ensure a sound design, seamless installation, and professional commissioning of our projects. The PM is a key position for our growing team and requires attention to detail in all aspects of planning and executing projects. Customer interface and management of staff require a high degree of effective human relations. Communication skills, both verbal and written, are important aspects of the PM position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

  

* + Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
  + Develop and manage project budgets, schedules, and work plans.
  + Assign tasks and manage resources to meet project goals.
  + Coordinate with internal departments, subcontractors, and vendors.
  + Ensure compliance with project specifications, codes, and safety standards.
  + Maintain accurate project documentation (RFIs, submittals, change orders, equipment logs, meeting minutes).

**Scheduling & Field Coordination**

  

* + Develop construction schedules and manpower plans.
  + Conduct pre-construction, progress, and close-out meetings.
  + Interface with inspectors and ensure all permits and fees are obtained.
  + Track material deliveries and adjust schedules as needed to maintain progress.

**Financial Management**

  

* + Prepare and manage budgets, cost forecasts, and billing schedules.
  + Review, estimate, and process change orders.
  + Support positive cash flow and assist with project close-out analysis.

**Customer & Team Communication**

  

* + Serve as the primary customer contact for all project phases.
  + Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Service, and Field Operations teams.
  + Identify and resolve project issues or conflicts efficiently.

**Major Responsibilities Breakdown**

  

* + Customer Coordination – 30%
  + RFI, Change Order, and Material Log – 20%
  + Construction Schedule Management – 20%
  + Monthly Billing Schedule – 10%
  + Interdepartmental Coordination – 10%
  + Other Duties – 10%

**Qualifications**

  

* + Construction Management, Engineering, or related field preferred.
  + 3 - 5 years proficient installation skills and understanding of fire alarm systems
  + 3 - 5 years of project management experience in **fire alarm, life safety, DAS, MDU, or low voltage construction**.
  + Proven ability to manage projects from inception through completion.
  + Strong familiarity with project management software, methodologies, and best practices.
  + Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.
  + Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  + Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  + Valid California driver’s license with a clean driving record.

**Physical and Environmental Demands:**

  

* + Sitting – Constantly (6-8 hours/daily)
  + Walking – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Standing- Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Standing on Ladder- Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Bending (Neck and Waist) – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Twisting (Neck and Waist) – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Lifting 0-20 Lbs. – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Carrying 0-20 Lbs. – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)

**Benefits include:**

  

* + Medical, Dental, Vision and Life, insurance plans – employee contributions required
  + Basic Life/AD&D Insurance and Long-Term Disability Insurance – covered by the employer
  + Discounted AFLAC is available at the employee's expense
  + 401K Retirement plan
  + Vacation days, dependent on the position
  + CA Paid Sick Leave earned at the rate per CA state law requirements
  + Paid Holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and the day after, Christmas Day

**Pyro-Comm Systems, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified candidates will be considered regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, genetic information, age, disability, or veteran status.**

**No Recruiters Please**

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager reports to the Director, Capital Program Delivery Infrastructure, and is responsible for developing, managing, and delivering of rail capital projects from capital planning, design, construction, and close out phases for the Peninsula Corridor Joint Powers Board (Caltrain). Essential Functions & Duties:

* Develop and manage the scope, schedule, and budget of Caltrain capital projects ensuring alignment with organizational goals and project objectives.
* Provide full life-cycle leadership from project execution planning, design, procurement, construction, systems integration, commissioning, and final closeout.
* Develop and maintain the project execution plan or/and project management plan PMP and support execution strategies to effective governance, risk mitigation, quality control and successful project delivery.
* Manage and coordinate all resources necessary to deliver assigned projects, including cross function departments within Rail and external consultants, Resident Engineer, Construction Management Staff, contractors, third parties and regulatory agencies throughout the project
* Ensure Safety First and Always Core Value is implemented through life cycle of project delivery.
* Work closely with the assigned project engineer(s) to ensure that all deliverables are compliant with Caltrain standards.
* Acts as the Point of Contact with internal and external stakeholders for assigned projects. Manage coordination and communications with all involved parties, including other agencies, third parties and tenant railroads
* Provide board and executive level reporting on project status, performance metrics and critical risks.
* Manage the Designer of Record and Construction Contractor to ensure delivery of the assigned projects.
* Oversee Project contract administration, change management and claim avoidance to protect Caltrain’s interest.
* Investigate, negotiate, and resolve project issues. Identify the root cause of problems and present appropriate solutions. Escalate issues to the Delivery Directors accordingly to ensure timely resolutions.

**Examples of Essential Duties:**

* Hold project meetings and represent assigned Caltrain projects at meetings, including monthly internal project reviews.
* Identify project delivery risks and develop risk mitigations and actions. Maintain and update project Risk Register.
* Perform the following project management duties; develop the scope of work, prepare and review cost estimates; monitor and produce status reports, schedules, and budgets; monitor work in progress; approve, negotiate, and execute, funding agreements and consultant contracts, authorizing contract payments per contract.
* Prepare staff reports and presentations for Management, the Board of Directors, and other stakeholders on assigned projects.
* Develop and maintain detail project staffing plans and project organization chart.
* Perform regular project budget, cost, schedule and funding reviews.
* Approval and issuance of project work directive and invoices.
* Develop and maintain project roles and responsivities matrix.
* Perform assessment of project delivery method.
* Be responsible for Project alternative study and Value Engineering effort.
* Negotiate, resolve or escalate project issues for timely resolution.
* Work collaboratively with key stakeholders to represent Caltrain for assigned projects.
* Perform all job duties and responsibilities safely to protect oneself, fellow employees, and the public from injury or harm. Promote safety awareness and follow safety procedures to reduce or eliminate accidents.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or construction management or equivalent
* Minimally five years’ full-time experience in project management of Rail or Transit Capital Projects
* Certified Project Manager Certificate

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* California Professional Engineer (PE) license is preferred.
* Experience in Rail Transportation or Construction Management.
* Experience in Delivery Capital Project in an operating environment.
* Possess strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Possess a California driver's license with a safe driving record.

Pay: $157,814.00 - $220,939.00 per year
