jobs.title: People Service Delivery Lead
jobs.description:
The People Service Delivery (PSD) team's mission is to run a high-performing, people-focused service delivery organization. Leading with care and empathy, we develop efficient processes, systems, and programs. We aim to ensure employees feel heard and have the resources and support they need during the most important moments so they can do impactful work. The People Service Delivery Lead sits at the intersection of people operations domain expertise and hands-on engineering. This role owns large-scale transformation programs end to end, and, unlike a traditional program role, also contributes to designing and building the solutions those programs depend on. This lead reads HR, payroll, and people-operations workflows fluently, identifies where the seams and inefficiencies are, and then helps architect tooling solutions that close them.Working closely with leaders across People Operations, executive sponsors, engineering, and other key XFN stakeholders, this lead challenges assumptions and the status quo to improve processes, reduce barriers, and mitigate risks. Much of the work is greenfield: problems arrive without a playbook, and this lead defines the path as they walk it. This person does not need to have the “correct” answer to everything. What matters is the ability to quickly drive the conversation toward a productive solution by bringing together the right people, process, and technology, including building a working prototype when that is the fastest way to create clarity.A key expectation of this role is to be an active driver of AI adoption and creative problem-solving in operations. This lead looks for opportunities to responsibly use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve consistency, accelerate resolution times, and enhance the employee experience while ensuring strong governance, quality, and appropriate handling of sensitive information.  
  
  

### **People Service Delivery Lead Responsibilities:**

* Own development, organization, and execution of large, complex business and operational programs from inception through delivery, with little to no oversight
* own the program roadmap and scoping, making tradeoffs to optimize time-to-release and clearly communicating goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes
* Deliver tooling that removes manual effort from people operations workflows
* Partner with Engineering to shape system design and technical direction, translating people operations needs into clear requirements
* Participate in design and solution reviews, holding a high-quality bar for what the team ships
* Deconstruct end-to-end employee lifecycle journeys (from hire through movement, leave, and exit) to identify seams, handoff failure points, and automation opportunities across teams and systems, then build the solutions that address them. Drive AI-enabled operational improvement, including identifying use cases for automation, workflow optimization, knowledge management, and case deflection, balancing efficiency with employee care and quality outcomes
* Improve efficiency and quality of systems and operations through end-to-end process frameworks and optimization initiatives, and design the change management that drives adoption of new processes, systems, or tooling, including training and communication plans for all levels, locations, and XFN partners
* Partner with HR Tech, engineering teams, and vendors to identify, build, and implement appropriate technology solutions
* oversee system integration efforts and ensure smooth transition and adoption
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate program risk proactively rather than reactively
* Move fluidly between audiences (SMEs, payroll leadership, engineering peers, and skip-level leadership), simplifying complex technical concepts for non-technical groups without losing precision, and maintaining open, candid, and trusting working relationships
* Monitor stabilization of changes to ensure processes and systems are executed per design

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in managing large-scale, global transformation or continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving business processes, systems, and operations, with demonstrable business results
* Domain knowledge of HR, payroll, or people-operations processes, or demonstrated experience in ramping quickly into a complex operational domain
* Experience designing or operating HR processes spanning multiple stages of the employee lifecycle (e.g., hire/onboarding, movement, leaves and time away, compensation and payroll events, and offboarding), with an understanding of how upstream decisions create downstream operational load
* Experience operating independently through ambiguity on greenfield problems, navigating competing and shifting priorities to maintain momentum, and delivering results in a detail-oriented, highly organized manner
* Experience problem-solving using data, translating thorough examination and analysis into action
* Experience working in an XFN environment: building relationships, consensus building, and motivating teams at all levels, technical and non-technical, to get colleagues on board with the benefits of transformational change

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge and understanding of the tech and software industry's business models and core processes
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

jobs.title: Program Manager, Executive Development
jobs.description:
People Development accelerates the performance of every Metamate, team, and leader — building the capabilities, culture, and human-AI partnerships that power Meta's future. We help people thrive through continuous change, grow more valuable over time, and choose to stay. We do this through coaching, team development, leadership experiences, performance systems, and skills at scale — all working as an integrated system, not a set of disconnected programs.This individual contributor role sits on the Executive Development team, which delivers best-in-class development to Meta's senior most leaders as they forge the future at a transformational moment in the company's history. You will be responsible for the delivery, execution and operations of Executive Development experiences, ensuring the work we do addresses real needs, is targeted, and makes a real difference to our leaders and the business.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Executive Development Responsibilities:**

* Own the delivery of Executive Development programs. Serve as the participant-facing program manager once a cohort is running, including in-session presence, cohort communications, and holding the experience standard live.
* Own in-person and virtual event execution: venues, vendors, production, print and delivery, and day-of execution — so logistics are invisible to leaders.
* Produce the materials senior leader experiences depend on — briefs, run-of-show documents, journals, and participant materials — to a consistent standard against real deadlines, in place early enough that senior leader and faculty time is immediately productive.
* Drive participants to a filled, ready cohort. Issue invitations, track nominations, confirmations and declines, chase non-responses through executive assistants, and drive required inputs — assessments, pre-work, forms, and closeout surveys — to completion, documenting exceptions.
* Build the repeatable processes behind each program, documented well enough that someone new could run it, and keep program assets current, findable, and reusable cycle over cycle — so delivery never depends on who is staffed.
* Own data capture and standing reporting. Capture data at the right moments in each program and maintain the reporting and quality checks built on it.
* Project-manage design and build work toward execution — workback plans, designer and vendor coordination, decision-gate readiness, and asset production.
* Manage contingent workers and vendors against a clear brief, holding delivery quality and timelines.
* Execute communications plans — drafting, sequencing, scheduling, sending, and tracking.
* Apply AI to how the team operates — automating and compressing internal workflows, reporting, tracking, and production, including completing privacy and sensitivity review.
* Support planning with delivery evidence. Bring participant and program data into quarterly planning, maintain team meeting materials and trackers, and surface delivery risk early.
* Jump in and manage evolving priorities, including planning and executing special projects and events as needed.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years experience developing and executing business and/or learning solutions
* 4+ years of program/project management experience running programs end to end
* Demonstrated track record of delivering high-touch programs or events for senior or executive audiences, where quality and discretion are non-negotiable
* Demonstrated track record of establishing credibility in front of senior leaders — able to hold a room of executives during delivery, read it, and adjust in the moment
* Demonstrated track record of building and maintaining trackers, operating procedures, and reporting that others rely on
* Demonstrated track record of attention to detail in participant-facing materials and communications
* Experience managing complex logistics for in-person and virtual experiences, including vendors and external suppliers
* Experience applying AI tools to automate or improve operational workflows
* Experience managing, structuring, and analyzing program data
* Experience managing contingent workers or vendors to a defined brief
* Entrepreneurial multi-tasker who can be highly efficient with ambiguity and complexity, and who stays calm when timelines compress

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Event management experience at executive level
* Project Management (PMP / PMI) certification
* Experience supporting executive assistants or executive offices
* Data analysis acumen
* Bachelor's Degree

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Executive Development
jobs.description:
People Development accelerates the performance of every Metamate, team, and leader — building the capabilities, culture, and human-AI partnerships that power Meta's future. We help people thrive through continuous change, grow more valuable over time, and choose to stay. We do this through coaching, team development, leadership experiences, performance systems, and skills at scale — all working as an integrated system, not a set of disconnected programs.This individual contributor role sits on the Executive Development team, which delivers best-in-class development to Meta's senior most leaders as they forge the future at a transformational moment in the company's history. You will focus on the strategy, planning, and operational systems of Executive Development and its learning experiences, ensuring the work we do addresses real needs, is targeted, and makes a real difference to our leaders and the business.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Executive Development Responsibilities:**

* Own the portfolio and prioritization system. Design and run the system and recurring reviews that keep all Executive Development work visible, scoped, and prioritized — including which design ideas are queued, committed, or parked, so the agenda is deliberate rather than reactive.
* Serve as strategic thought partner to the VP, Executive Development. Bring evidence, options, and a recommendation, and guide annual and quarterly planning.
* Protect team and senior leader capacity. Sequence high-value design and delivery work, make overcommitment visible before it affects delivery, flag when timelines are at risk of collapsing, and escalate with ranked options rather than problems.
* Own everything that happens before a cohort starts: curation and selection, the invitation list and cohort timing, the design cycle and its decision gates, and the faculty partnership — setting the experience standard the program is held to.
* Develop the faculty, coach, and vendor bench. Build bench depth, define how facilitators are matched to programs, and run the quality evaluation that informs future assignments.
* Partner with the VP and design partners on the design and modernization of learning experiences. Bring delivery, participant, and measurement evidence, pressure-test feasibility, and translate design intent into work the team can build and run.
* Build new offerings end to end — the build plan, coordination with designers, decision gates, and the launch and communications strategy for an executive audience, including leading socialization with senior stakeholders directly.
* Build and ship AI-enabled learning experiences that modernize how senior leaders learn, reflect, and are coached — judging what should be AI-enabled versus left human, and holding the bar on participant experience and privacy.
* Own measurement and the insight narrative. Define what we measure and why, synthesize themes across programs, and answer "is this working?" with evidence that shapes investment and retirement decisions.
* Build relationships and influence cross-functional partners early. Work with recruiting and HR partners while new initiatives are still being shaped, securing early line of sight into changes that affect the portfolio.
* Jump in and manage evolving priorities, including planning and executing special projects as needed.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years experience developing and executing business and/or learning solutions
* Entrepreneurial multi-tasker who can be highly efficient with ambiguity and complexity
* Demonstrated track record of leading strategy and planning work in complex environments
* Demonstrated track record of owning a portfolio or system of programs — not only individual programs — including prioritization and capacity trade-off decisions
* Demonstrated track record of thinking strategically and acting operationally while managing ambiguity, risk, and changing direction
* Demonstrated track record of developing and delivering communications for an executive audience, including change management and go-to-market plans
* Demonstrated track record of background in working directly with VP-level or equivalent senior leaders
* Experience as a strategic thought partner to senior executives, with demonstrated influence on what an organization chooses to work on

jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**About Overwatch Mission Critical**

Overwatch is a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business (SDVOB) certified through the National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC), offering construction professional services, talent acquisition, and general contractor services for the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

Our mission is the construction and management of state-of-the-art data centers with the precision and reliability this industry demands. From high-end engineers to seasoned professionals, we deploy the people you need to get your data center off the ground. At Overwatch, it's more than a job — it's purpose.

**Overview**

**Scope of Work**

**1. Quality Program Oversight & Auditing**

* Audit the GC’s QA/QC Plan: Review and approve the contractor’s Quality Management Plan. Ensure they have the staff and processes to manage a hyperscale-level scope.
* Surveillance & Spot Checks: Perform independent field walks and "pothole" inspections to verify that the GC’s reporting matches the physical reality on-site.
* BIM & VDC Alignment: Ensure that field installations match the coordinated 3D models and that "clash-free" designs are maintained during high-density MEP installs.

**2. Technical System Validation (Civil, Structural, MEP)**

* **Electrical Infrastructure:** Oversee the quality of Medium Voltage (MV) and Low Voltage (LV) systems, UPS plants, and backup generators.
* **Mechanical/Cooling:** Validate the integrity of chilled water loops, CRAH/CRAC units, and massive air-handling systems.
* **Envelope & Shell:** Ensure the "white space" is airtight and meets specific humidity and particulate requirements.

**3. Issue Management & Resolution**

* **Non-Conformance Reports (NCR):** Review all NCRs issued by the GC. For major issues, lead the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to ensure the defect doesn't repeat across the campus.
* **Punch List Management:** Drive the "Zero-Punch" philosophy, ensuring issues are caught during installation rather than at the end of the project.

**4. Commissioning (Cx) Liaison**

* **Level 1 through Level 5 Testing:** Act as the bridge between construction and the Commissioning Agent (CxA). Verify that Level 1 (Factory Acceptance) and Level 2 (Site Acceptance) testing is documented correctly before moving to integrated systems testing (IST).
* **Document Control:** Ensure all Operations & Maintenance (O&M) manuals, warranties, and as-builts are pristine and ready for the Owner's Operations team.

**Sub Specialty Area**

* Quality Assurance & Quality Control

**Required Experience**

* Experience: 7–10+ years in construction quality management, with at least 3–5 years specifically in Mission Critical or Hyperscale Data Center environments.

**Data Center Years Exp**

* 4 Years

**Driver’s License Requirement**

For roles that require on-site presence or travel between work locations as an essential function of the position, candidates must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license appropriate for the role and be eligible to operate a motor vehicle in accordance with applicable laws.

Patelco Credit Union is a not-for-profit credit union with a purpose to build financial health and wellbeing for our members. Since 1936, Patelco has grown from $500 in assets to over $9 billion in assets and is the 7th largest credit union in California with branches throughout Northern California.

If you’re looking to use your skills and knowledge to make a difference in our members’ lives, Patelco could be the perfect fit for you.

Overview:

Patelco Credit Union is looking for a Risk Analytics & Data/AI Governance Senior Program Manager to help strengthen how we identify, understand, monitor, and report risk across the organization. This role will use data, analytics, and governance practices to help leaders make informed decisions that support our members, our business, and our long-term risk management goals.

This role will lead analytics-driven risk initiatives, modernize risk reporting capabilities, and help advance Data and AI governance practices across the enterprise. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the Program Manager will help develop reliable risk insights, improve reporting processes, and support strong governance practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical expertise with experience in credit, financial, or enterprise risk management. You are comfortable translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for executives, governance committees, and business partners. This is a highly collaborative role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, influencing stakeholders, and driving continuous improvement in risk analytics and governance practices.

Responsibilities:

* Lead analytics-driven risk initiatives that improve how financial, credit, operational, and emerging risks are identified, monitored, and reported.
* Build and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytics that help senior leaders and governance committees understand key risk trends and make better decisions.
* Analyze credit portfolio trends, risk concentrations, delinquency, losses, and other indicators to identify emerging risks and business implications.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to define and improve key risk indicators, data definitions, reporting standards, and governance routines.
* Support Data and AI governance activities, including documentation, use case intake, risk assessment, monitoring, and data quality expectations.
* Prepare clear, executive-ready analyses, updates, and recommendations for management, board, audit, regulatory, and governance-related needs.
* Improve reporting automation, consistency, and documentation to reduce manual work and increase confidence in risk information.

Qualifications:

* 7+ years of experience in analytics, credit risk, financial risk, enterprise risk management, data governance, or a related field.
* Experience working in a credit union, banking, fintech, or other regulated financial services environment.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit risk, portfolio analytics, risk indicators, trend analysis, and performance reporting.
* Ability to work with large datasets and use analytical tools such as SQL, Python, R, or similar technologies.
* Experience creating or improving dashboards, automated reports, data models, or analytics processes.
* Experience with business intelligence or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

**Why Join Ivo?**
=================

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.
  
  
Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**  
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Mid Market Customer Success Manager with a background in SaaS customer success or account management to own a growing portfolio of mid-market accounts. This role is central to ensuring our customers derive maximum value from our product, at scale. You'll balance a higher volume of accounts than our enterprise team, relying on efficient, repeatable processes to drive onboarding, adoption, and renewals across a broad book of business.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* **Scaled Onboarding & Success Planning:** Lead efficient, templated onboarding for a high volume of accounts, tailoring success plans just enough to fit each customer's core goals without sacrificing speed.
* **Customer Support & Issue Resolution:** Act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries across your portfolio, triaging and resolving issues quickly to keep accounts healthy.
* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own and manage a large book of mid-market accounts, prioritizing your time based on risk, opportunity, and usage signals to drive retention across the full portfolio.
* **Customer Education at Scale:** Provide product demonstrations, lead training sessions, and guide customers through best practices, ensuring they become experts in our solution.
* **Product Advocacy & Business Reviews:** Build and maintain support content, playbooks, and best-practice documentation; run streamlined business reviews that scale across many accounts.
* **Growth & Retention Plans:** Identify renewal and upsell opportunities early using data and usage patterns, and execute standardized playbooks to secure them.
* **Value Focused:** Develop a working understanding of each customer's use case quickly, so you can address common problems efficiently across similar accounts.
* **Trusted Advisor:** Build relationships across a wide portfolio through regular, efficient touch points — proactive outreach, check-ins, and escalation management.
* **Usage and Adoption:** Drive adoption through scalable engagement tactics (in-app guidance, email campaigns, office hours) rather than bespoke, high-touch engagement.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Spot patterns and trends across your portfolio and feed them back internally to inform product and process improvements.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 3-7 years of experience in a SaaS customer success or account management role, ideally managing a high-volume portfolio of mid-market accounts; experience in legal tech or with legal professionals is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to manage a large book of business efficiently without sacrificing customer satisfaction.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills: you're presentable, pleasant, and confident in driving conversations, including over the phone and in group settings.
* Strong understanding of customer success strategies, retention planning, and scalable, process-driven account management.
* Comfort with prioritization and triage — knowing where to spend your limited time across many accounts.

**Ivo might be a good fit for you if you:**

* Would describe yourself as being relentlessly resourceful.
* Have a strong internal sense of urgency. You have a bias toward doing things today, rather than tomorrow.
* Experience working in a startup environment is preferred but not required.
* Are excited about the adventure of building a company!

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Final offer details are determined based on experience, expertise, and overall fit.
* **Equity:** Meaningful ownership in a company that's scaling fast.
* **Relocation and Visa Support:** We also offer relocation assistance for successful applicants moving to SF, as well as support for visa and green card applications where applicable.
* **Health & Wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to suit the needs of you and your family.
* **Flexible Spending & Insurance:** Access to HSA and FSA accounts, plus life insurance coverage.
* **401(k) Program:** Save for the future with our 401(k) program.
* **Commuter Benefits:** We help make getting to and from the office easier and more convenient.
* **Unlimited PTO:** So you can take the time you need to recharge, stay healthy, and bring your best self to work.

**FAQ**

* *What stage of growth is Ivo at?:* We recently raised our Series B after growing 6x in 12 months.
* *Is this a chill gig?:* Startups are very hard, especially if they’re growing fast. You’ll have a ton of responsibility, and there’s always an enormous amount of stuff to do. It’s hard work but the payoff is uncapped.

Enjoy meaningful work while contributing to an organization that changes lives every day. **US Fertility**, the nation’s leading partnership of physician-led fertility practices, is redefining what it means to build a career in reproductive medicine.

Our team members choose to build their career home at US Fertility because of the **hope we inspire in our patients**, the **lives we help bring into the world**, and the **culture of excellence we foster across our organization**. We share a deep commitment to continuously improving the patient experience and advancing research and development in one of the most dynamic and impactful fields of medicine.

Through our national network of premier fertility centers—including **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area**—we combine clinical expertise, scientific innovation, and compassionate care. The work we do building families offers purpose, challenge, and personal reward—and we’re just getting started.  
  
**Opportunity Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Patient Care Coordinator** to join our team at **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area** in **Menlo Park, California.**

* **Schedule:** Tuesday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, one weekend per month and two holidays per year
* **Compensation:** $28 to $35 per hour (commensurate with experience)

This role provides the opportunity to grow within a nationally respected organization while remaining closely connected to the patients and teams you support every day.  
  
**How You’ll Contribute**  
  
At US Fertility, collaboration is fundamental to how we work. There is undeniable strength in numbers—and support is always within reach. Whether collaborating with more than **200 highly respected physicians nationwide** or partnering with colleagues who are passionate about solving meaningful problems, you’ll be surrounded by a team committed to shared success.

In this role, the **Patient Care Coordinator** will:

* Assist with the clinical care of fertility patients
* Provide patient/couple counseling, procedure teaching, communicates physician orders and instructions
* Provide pre and post op education
* Establish a compassionate environment by providing emotional and psychological support to patients and patients' families
* Work independently to assure the program goals are achieved
* Support and promote excellence in customer service

**What You’ll Bring**  
  
We’re looking for professionals who bring both technical skill and a deep sense of responsibility to the care experience—individuals who thrive in environments where excellence, empathy, and accountability matter.

**Qualifications and Skills Include:**

* Excellent oral and written communication, interpersonal and customer service skills
* High School Diploma or GED
* Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment

More important than any single credential, however, is the *right person*. Team members who are most successful at US Fertility embrace our mission, live our values, and remain committed to continuous improvement—for themselves, their colleagues, and the patients we serve.  
  
**What We Offer**

* Employee wellness and recognition programs

**Per Diem Employees**

* 401(k) with company match
* Employee wellness and recognition programs

US Fertility and its network partners believe that a **diverse workforce is essential** to fulfilling our mission of expanding patient access to the highest standards of fertility care. We are committed to equitable and inclusive hiring practices that ensure our clinical and operational teams reflect and support the diverse communities and patients we serve.  
  
Across our national footprint, US Fertility is a leader in offering **clinical, administrative, and operational career opportunities** at locations throughout the United States. We are equally committed to developing individual strengths, promoting from within, and supporting long-term career growth.  
  
This is a moment of growth, innovation, and impact. **Take the next step in your career with US Fertility—and help shape the future of fertility care.**

Huntridge Labs is a digital engineering company focused on delivering modern solutions for public benefit that are backed by emerging technologies.

Regardless of the role you are applying for, you will be a great fit in Huntridge Labs if this describes you:

You are a top performer in your current role

You enjoy succeeding as a team

You love solving problems and trying new things

You hate bureaucracy, red tape, and wasteful processes

When you see something that's broken, you fix it

"That's not my job" doesn't exist in your vocabulary

Quantum Sky is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Channel Account Manager** to manage, and scale our channel partner ecosystem. This leader will be responsible for developing and executing a channel strategy that drives revenue growth, expands market reach, increases partner engagement, and creates a predictable pipeline of channel-sourced and channel-influenced opportunities.

The Channel Account Manager will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and executive leadership to recruit the right partners, develop productive relationships, establish effective partner programs, and equip partners to successfully sell and deliver our solutions.

This is a highly visible, revenue-focused role for a strategic channel leader who can operate at both the executive and field level.

**Responsibilities:**

**Channel Strategy & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive channel strategy aligned with company revenue and growth objectives.
* Establish annual and quarterly channel revenue targets, pipeline goals, and partner performance metrics.
* Build a scalable channel model that increases indirect revenue while complementing the direct sales organization.
* Develop channel forecasts and provide regular reporting to executive leadership.
* Own the channel contribution to pipeline, bookings, revenue, and overall company growth.
* Manage existing relationships with AWS, Google, Microsoft and Carahsoft.

**Partner Recruitment & Development**

* Identify, recruit, onboard, and develop high-value channel partners, including resellers, referral partners, strategic partners, and other relevant partner types.
* Develop strong relationships with partner executives, sales leaders, and key stakeholders.
* Establish clear partner qualification criteria and prioritize partners based on revenue potential, market coverage, capabilities, and strategic fit.
* Create joint business plans with key partners and establish measurable objectives.
* Develop strategies to increase partner activation, productivity, retention, and revenue contribution.

**Partner Enablement**

* Build and manage partner onboarding and enablement programs.
* Ensure partners have the training, tools, messaging, collateral, pricing information, and resources required to effectively position and sell our solutions.
* Work with Sales Enablement and Marketing to create scalable partner training and certification programs.
* Establish regular partner communications, business reviews, training sessions, and sales planning activities.

**Pipeline & Sales Execution**

* Work directly with partners and internal sales teams to identify, qualify, and advance opportunities.
* Establish a repeatable process for partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities.
* Collaborate with Account Executives on joint account planning, opportunity strategy, and deal execution.
* Drive partner participation in demand-generation activities and campaigns.
* Monitor channel pipeline health, conversion rates, deal velocity, and partner performance.
* Help resolve channel conflicts and establish clear rules of engagement between direct and indirect sales teams.

**Partner Program Management**

* Continuously improve the company's channel partner program.
* Develop programs that reward productive partners and encourage increased investment in our business.
* Partner with Finance and Operations to ensure channel programs are financially sound, scalable, and operationally efficient.
* Establish KPIs and dashboards to measure partner performance and program effectiveness.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the internal advocate and subject-matter expert for the channel organization.
* Collaborate closely with Sales leadership to align direct and indirect go-to-market strategies.
* Partner with Marketing to develop co-marketing, demand-generation, and partner-led campaigns.
* Work with Product and Product Marketing to communicate market and partner feedback.
* Collaborate with Customer Success and Professional Services to ensure partners can successfully support customers.
* Provide executive leadership with market intelligence, partner feedback, competitive insights, and recommendations.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Channel-sourced and channel-influenced revenue
* Channel pipeline generation and growth
* Partner-sourced opportunities
* Partner retention and expansion
* Pipeline conversion and win rates
* Revenue per active partner
* Contribution of the channel to overall company growth

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in channel sales, partner sales, alliances, business development, or a related B2B sales leadership role.
* Demonstrated success building and scaling channel or partner programs.
* Proven track record of achieving revenue and pipeline targets through partners.
* Experience working with reseller, distributor, referral, technology, or strategic partners.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to develop strategy while remaining highly hands-on in execution.

**Desired:**

* Experience in working with AWS, Google, Microsoft and Carahsoft.
* Existing relationships within the AWS, Google, Microsoft and Carahsoft.

**Location:**

* Remote but in the DC, MD, VA metro area

**Travel:**

* Minimal

The Deputy Project Manager supports the Project Manager in the planning, coordination, and execution of complex VA initiatives supporting VistA transition and EHR modernization activities. This position is fully remote within the United States, with core business hours Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time. Periodic weekend support is required during EHRM deployment and cutover events.

Responsibilities:

* Support the Project Manager in managing day-to-day program execution, priorities, deliverables, and stakeholder commitments.

* Translate client requirements and strategic direction into actionable plans, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Monitor scope, schedule, risks, dependencies, issues, and resource requirements across multiple concurrent activities.
* Identify emerging requirements, anticipate challenges, and develop practical solutions before they impact delivery.
* Ensure team activities, accomplishments, risks, and emerging work are accurately tracked, documented, maintained, and communicated to leadership.
* Support development of executive briefings, status reports, presentations, project plans, and other program deliverables.
* Facilitate cross-functional reporting and meetings, drive action items to closure, and maintain accountability for commitments.

* Serve as a trusted advisor and extension of project leadership, promoting collaboration, adaptability, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems, Business, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
* Fifteen (15) or more years of work experience required.
* Ten (10) years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for the required degree.
* Project Team oriented mindset with excellent written and oral communication skills with good decision-making, interpersonal skills.
* Experience leading geographically dispersed teams in a remote environment.
* Collaboration: Working closely with other teams, such as development, engineering, and project management, to support the delivery of solutions.
* Ability to work independently and conduct research with minimal guidance and supervision
* Experience in operating in an agile environment is desirable, but not required
* Experience within a large Enterprise Health IT environment, specifically with VA

**Preferred Experience**

* 5 to 8 years of experience supporting enterprise level projects at the Department of Veteran Affairs

**Clearance Required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance

Posted Salary Range: USD $130,000.00 - USD $140,000.00 /Yr.

jobs.description:
Join Amplity, the full-service go-to partner of biopharma companies that delivers flexible + specialized medical + commercial services. No matter where a drug is in its lifecycle, we scale with ease to maximize resources + improve impact for all our clients. Through strategic partnerships + deep therapeutic expertise, Amplity transforms how breakthrough treatments reach the people who need them.

**Program Manager – Medical**

**Business Unit:** Global Medical Solutions  
**Reports to:** VP, Global Medical Solutions or Senior Program Director, Medical  
**Location:** Field-based  
**Role Type:** People Manager  
**Travel:** 50% or more, including global travel

***Eastern and Central time zones preferred****.*

We have a current opportunity for a US based Medical Program Manager role. Use your pharmaceutical medical affairs people leadership experience as we grow our team. Amplity provides a competitive base salary, bonus potential, auto allowance, full benefit package including dental, medical, vision, 401K, long term/short term disability, paid holidays, generous PTO and more.

Amplity partners with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to help bring medicines to patients quickly, safely, and effectively. Our capabilities span medical, sales, insights, communications, and learning solutions across the product lifecycle.

**Role Overview**

The Program Manager – Medical leads one large or several smaller field-based medical teams, which may include Medical Science Liaisons, Patient Diagnosis Liaisons, Clinical Trial Liaisons, and Clinical Nurse Educators. This role is accountable for client delivery, team performance, compliant scientific engagement, and the retention and growth of assigned programs.

* Medical Affairs experience required
* Demonstrated people leadership, coaching, and performance management experience.
* Ability to critically evaluate and communicate complex scientific and clinical information.
* Knowledge of compliance requirements and industry codes governing field-based medical teams.
* Strong client focus, judgment, listening, communication, planning, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**Additional Requirements**

* Willing and able to travel 50% or more, including international travel.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Planning and organization

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Care Navigator  
**Job Location:** Remote with possibility of going into wellness center in Victorville, CA

**Company Description:**  
Greater Good Health is a community of healthcare providers, operators, and builders whose mission is to address health disparities and reimagine senior healthcare. To do this, we partner with payers to bring value-based primary care to underserved communities and work alongside risk-bearing organizations to develop innovative, value-based clinical programs– all designed exclusively for older adults and their unique healthcare needs. Grounded in our mission and core values, we are building a better, simpler healthcare experience for the patients we serve and the providers who care for them.  
  
While providing more access to care, we understand that Nurse Practitioners need optimal work-life alignment to provide the best care for the greater good. GGH’s goal is to support the modern-day healthcare professional to live fully in both their

professional and personal lives.  
  
If this vision resonates with you, we hope you consider bringing your passion, your energy, your curiosity to Greater Good Health.

**The Role**

The GGH Care Navigator plays a critical role as the primary point of contact for engaging patients, coordinating their care across settings, and connecting them to the right resources at the right time. Successful Care Navigators are excellent communicators, empathetic, and have a strong work ethic and desire to positively impact the quality of care delivered by GGH. They are welcoming and courteous, possess superior active listening and critical thinking skills, and are comfortable with multitasking and problem-solving. Care Navigators serve as patient advocates — removing barriers to care, supporting patients through complex health journeys, and ensuring that no patient falls through the cracks. They must also be skilled at relating to the geriatric population, building trust, and making patients feel supported at every step of their healthcare experience.  
  
**Applicants must be comfortable working 8a–5p (PST).**  
  
**Typical Duties**  
**Patient Outreach & Engagement**

* Conduct proactive outreach to schedule patient home, telehealth, and in-clinic visits to complete Annual Wellness Visits (AWVs), ensuring patients receive timely preventative care and individualized care plans.
* Accept inbound calls from patients to schedule AWVs and address care-related questions or concerns.
* Connect with the geriatric population to build trusting, long-term relationships — making patients feel calm, comfortable, and heard throughout their care experience.
* Identify and address barriers to engagement, including transportation, language, health literacy, financial hardship, and other social and environmental factors.
* Outreach to patients to complete key preventative screenings (colon cancer, mammograms, diabetic retina scans, HbA1c, and more), documenting outreach and establishing follow-through plans.

**Care Coordination & Panel Management**

* Partner closely with assigned GGH Nurse Practitioners (NPs) to co-manage their patient panel, serving as the day-to-day coordination hub for scheduling, care follow-through, and patient communication.
* Build and optimize driving routes for GGH Nurse Practitioners completing home visits, maximizing time spent with patients.
* Coordinate patient cancellations, reschedules, and add-on visits with the NP to ensure continuity of care and efficient schedule management.
* Retrieve and reconcile medical records from outside providers, hospitals, health systems, and community organizations to ensure the care team has a complete and current view of each patient’s health history.
* Manage patients post-discharge from hospital or skilled nursing facility settings, coordinating timely follow-up visits and facilitating care plan transitions to reduce readmission risk.
* Follow up with patients on outstanding provider orders — including lab work, imaging, specialist referrals, and durable medical equipment — ensuring completion and routing results back to the care team.
* Coordinate referrals and activities for high-risk programs, facilitating smooth transitions between care settings and service providers.
* Support the care team in identifying and closing quality gaps, including HEDIS measures and chronic disease management needs.

**Compliance & Documentation**

* Handle protected health information (PHI) with discretion, adhering to HIPAA standards and GGH privacy policies at all times.
* Maintain timely, accurate, and thorough documentation of all patient interactions, outreach attempts, care coordination activities, and follow-up plans.

**Collaboration & Program Development**

* Build strong, positive working relationships with GGH Nurse Practitioners and the Patient Outreach Team, and maintain professional communications with client partners and the broader care team.
* Participate in interdisciplinary care team meetings, contributing patient updates and coordinating action steps across team members.
* Maintain collaborative relationships with clinicians and the leadership team to support the development of new programs aimed at improving patient engagement, care coordination, and health outcomes.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Key Success Outcomes**

* Completing 50–100 outbound calls per day.
* Achieving conversion rate expectations for AWV scheduling and preventative care outreach.
* Successfully managing post-discharge follow-up to minimize care gaps and reduce avoidable readmissions.
* Timely retrieval and reconciliation of outside medical records to support care team decision-making.
* High completion rates on outstanding provider orders through consistent, proactive patient follow-up.
* Building and maintaining strong professional relationships with the Care Navigator team and GGH Nurse Practitioners.
* Timely, accurate, and thorough documentation in all systems of record.

*First/second shift schedule, including weekends. Four 10-hour days per week.*

  

We are seeking an Operations Representative ('Safety Analyst' title internally) to join Gaggle's Operations Team in reviewing and analyzing online activity of K-12 students. This is a unique opportunity that offers a chance to make a real difference in the lives of millions of students across the country. This position requires focus and dedication to make quick and accurate decisions on repetitive work.

This team is credited with uncovering bullying, threats of violence, suicide attempts, self-harm situations, domestic abuse, mental health struggles, drug abuse, and many other situations where a student needs intervention from a caring adult.

**What you will be doing**

* Reviewing and analyzing student activity to identify a need for intervention related to student safety or well-being while maintaining quality and efficiency goals set in place to ensure quick delivery of actionable information to emergency contacts
* Communicating with our customers, designated emergency contacts, at a school district to relay important information
* Fielding phone calls and emails from customers about student incidents in a responsive, resourceful, and professional manner
* Applying sound judgment and knowledge from previous related experience to make the best decisions to keep students safe
* Recording and maintaining concise notes regarding each incident in Salesforce CRM
* Identifying trends, utilizing research to make decisions, and collaborating with other Operations Analysts to make recommendations for decision strategy
* Working closely with department leadership to develop processes and procedures to reach company goals
* Auditing decisions made by others with a focus on accuracy and efficiency to improve the quality of decisions made on the team
* Operating as a single contributor on a team with a high level of ownership of individual outcomes

**What you should have**

* Experience using a variety of desktop and web-based applications. We use Salesforce, Service Cloud, Slack and Sling here at Gaggle
* Experience in crisis management, child advocacy, content moderation, or a related field or degree
* A strong comfort level in communicating sensitive information through email, text, and phone to convey the seriousness of a situation
* The ability to stay focused on the same task for long uninterrupted periods. You must be able to process large amounts of content quickly and accurately
* A passion for reading. You will read a lot of material as you review and analyze student content, so excellent reading comprehension is important
* Confidence to operate independently and autonomously within a virtual team environment and the ability to reach goals with minimal supervision
* A high degree of ownership of individual outcomes and contribution to the department and company goals.
* A passion for continuous improvement and a willingness to manage change with grace
* Fluency in Spanish is a plus

* This role requires sedentary and/or light-duty office work as well as high visual acuity; candidates must be able to work for up to ten hours a day while looking at a computer screen, reading material on a computer screen and sitting for long periods of time.
* This team operates 24/7. Work days may require flexibility and extended hours, depending on volume.

You will manage a network of distributors who sell and distribute Gasboy product solutions. You will work to prospect and develop end fleet sales opportunities with our distributor partners. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and various external stakeholders to define, implement, and maintain an effective sales strategy and bring in cross functional support team members as needed. * Dig into CSAT, NPS, QA, FCR, and AHT data to find gaps in workflows and knowledge, then turn them into specific fixes
* Partner with our internal QA team and BPO leadership on calibrations, 1:1 coaching, and performance improvement plans, serving as the liaison between support leadership and agents
* Build and maintain FAQs and agent macros that drive self-service and agent efficiency
* Work with our AI Lead to identify automation and deflection opportunities, and implement internal tools that improve resolution times and CSAT

**We're looking for someone who:**
----------------------------------

* Has 5+ years in Customer Experience, Support Operations, CX Ops, QA, Training, or Knowledge Management
* Has 2+ years in a managerial role, or an equivalent independent-contributor role with real ownership
* Has worked directly with BPO teams
* Has created and maintained documentation (SOPs, macros, help articles, templates) that a frontline team actually uses
* Has mastered analyzing CX performance reporting: CSAT, quality scoring, contact drivers, first response time, and resolution quality
* Is hands-on with a support platform (Gladly, Zendesk, Gorgias, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar), a knowledge tool (Notion, Confluence, Guru, or similar), and QA workflows (scorecards, sampling, calibration)
* Is strong in Google Workspace and builds trackers and reporting in Sheets with ease (pivot tables, filters, structured logs)
* Bonus: has used AI tools or built AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code)

**Approach to the role:**
-------------------------

* Runs a regimented cadence: sets the rhythm, hits deadlines, and keeps programs moving without reminders
* Obsesses over clarity: writes things so anyone can execute them and removes ambiguity wherever it hides
* Thinks in patterns: spots repeat issues fast, tags them consistently, and turns them into fixes
* Balances customer-first with policy discipline: empathetic and flexible, but grounded in what we can promise and deliver
* Collaborates without creating drag: brings solutions, not noise
* Leads virtual training with a flexible schedule across time zones, and isn't afraid to take an escalation call when it counts
* Owns the outcome with extreme ownership, with no micromanagement needed and always ten steps ahead

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package—grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is between **$100,000 – $110,000 plus bonus** depending on experience.

Beyond base salary, we offer competitive equity packages and a comprehensive set of benefits designed to support the well-being, growth, and balance of our team.

**A bit about us...**

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There's an infinite number of "nutrition" companies, all focused on what's best for them — not what's best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We've seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

  

**What we care about...**

**Be the Best:** We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

**Own It:** We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

**Drive Impact, Urgently:** We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

  

**Compensation & Perks:**

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage - for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

**Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

**Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA.

**Compensation** $75,000 to $105,000 base.

**Travel** Occasional travel to Las Vegas for quarterly planning and major project kickoffs.

**About the Role**

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas.

We are hiring a Project Manager to join our Program Management team, reporting directly to the Co-CEOs. You will work side by side with our Director of Program Management, the senior member of the team, and take full ownership of a slate of live projects across engineering, product, AI, and marketing.

Your job is delivery. You take each project from intake to closeout: scope, plan, schedule, risks, dependencies, status, and the retrospective at the end. On any project you own, leadership always knows where it stands and the team always knows what happens next.

Technical work runs in Jira. Marketing work runs in Monday. Documentation lives in Confluence. You work fluently across all three.

**Who Should Apply**

We are especially open to candidates from these backgrounds:

* Project Managers at software, digital, or product companies who have run several concurrent projects and can show the numbers they moved
* Technical Project Managers who have delivered engineering work and are comfortable coordinating with marketing
* Agency or professional services Project Managers who have owned SOWs, scope changes, and client reporting and want to go in-house
* Marketing or Growth Operations professionals who have grown into full-lifecycle project ownership

Titles vary. A track record of shipping on time is the bar.

**What You'll Find on Day One**

* Operations and technical teams actively running their work in Jira, with sprints, boards, and owners in place

* Marketing projects running in Monday, with hand-offs to engineering that need a clear owner
* A draft intake and governance framework that needs to be tested on real projects
* A Director of Program Management as your senior teammate, and Co-CEOs who read project status every week

**What You'll Own**

**Project Delivery, End to End**

* Own a slate of concurrent projects from intake through closeout. Write the project charter for each: objective, success metric, sponsor, scope, milestones, and budget where one applies.
* Break scope into a work breakdown, a realistic schedule, and a critical path. Keep baselines honest as the work evolves.
* Choose the delivery approach that fits the work: predictive, Agile, or hybrid.
* Run kickoffs, working sessions, and project standups for the projects you own. Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives where a team needs them.
* Close every project with a retrospective and a lessons-learned entry in Confluence.

**Scope, Change, and Risk Control**

* Guard scope. Every change request gets a written impact on timeline, cost, and resources, and a named decision-maker.
* Maintain a RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) for every project. Surface each risk early with a proposed mitigation.
* Map dependencies between engineering and marketing and resolve them before they become blockers.
* Manage vendor and contractor deliverables against their statements of work.

**Status, Reporting, and Stakeholder Communication**

* Publish a weekly status for each project: health, progress against milestones, risks, and decisions needed. Short, specific, and read once.
* Feed accurate project-level data into the portfolio view the Director of Program Management presents to the Co-CEOs.
* Tailor communication to the audience. An engineer, a marketer, and a Co-CEO each get the level of detail they need.
* Escalate early when a project is at risk. Bring the problem, the options, and your recommendation.

**Tool Hygiene and Process Improvement**

* Keep every project you own clean in Jira and Monday: named owners, due dates, current status, and a definition of done.
* Lead the cleanup of legacy epics from abandoned projects. Confirm status with the original teams, archive or close what is finished or dead, and re-plan anything that still matters.
* Apply the draft intake and governance framework on live projects and report back on what works and what needs to change.
* Build templates, checklists, and runbooks so each new project starts faster than the last.

**Supporting the OKR Cadence**

* Link each of your projects to the Key Result it serves, so every project has a clear line to a company objective.
* Support the Director of Program Management in running quarterly OKR planning and weekly check-ins in Monday: prepare the data, collect updates, and track follow-ups to closure.

**Required Qualifications**

* Three or more years of hands-on project management experience delivering software, digital, or marketing projects, with several projects running at once.
* A delivery record you can quantify. On-time rates, cycle times, defect rates, or budget performance you improved, and by how much.
* Command of core project management practice: charters, schedules, critical path, RAID logs, change control, and stakeholder management.

jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Overview**
============

Instacart is on a mission to make eating well effortless for everyone and great design is a key ingredient. As a Senior Design Program Manager, you'll drive operational excellence and programmatic execution across the Design organization—building AI-enabled systems, scaling critical processes, and managing the tools and vendor relationships that power our creative work.

This role sits at the intersection of design craft, technical operations, and strategic execution. You'll bring strong design sensibility—whether from product design or design systems—to build scalable programs, automate workflows using AI, and ensure our design team has the infrastructure, tools, and processes to deliver world-class experiences efficiently. You'll work closely with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team, requiring technical fluency to bridge design, engineering, and tooling infrastructure.

**About the Role**
==================

You'll own end-to-end program execution for high-visibility design initiatives while building the operational backbone that enables the Design organization to scale. You'll leverage AI to automate workflows, manage critical vendor relationships (Figma, design tooling, contractors), and create repeatable systems that translate our design, creative and product strategy into shipped experiences.

You'll report to the Director of Technical Program Management and work closely with Design and Product Leadership, Marketing, Engineering, and several other cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter.

**About the Job**
=================

* **Programmatic Execution:** Drive end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-quarter design initiatives across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Business Development and other cross-functional teams. Enable seamless cross-functional collaboration and predictable program outcomes.
* **AI Enablement:** Build and deploy AI-enabled workflows that automate program management tasks—status reporting, resource tracking, documentation synthesis, and stakeholder communication. Champion AI fluency in Design to accelerate design-first thinking and increase operational efficiency.
* **Operations & Vendor Management:** Own strategic vendor relationships and contract management for design tooling (Figma, prototyping, asset management, collaboration platforms). Negotiate contracts, optimize licensing spend, and ensure infrastructure scales with growth. Manage contractor/agency relationships and partner with Finance, Legal, and IT on compliance and cost efficiency.
* **Systems & Tooling:** Champion team health through capacity planning, roadmapping, and resource allocation. Build operational metrics and tooling integrations that create seamless workflows across platforms.
* **Design Systems & Cross-Functional Partnership:** Partner with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team to align programs with system evolution and component adoption. Drive governance programs that scale IDS across product teams. Act as strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Operations. Translate design strategy into executable programs with clear visibility into progress and outcomes. Facilitate planning cycles and milestone reviews where design intersects with product roadmaps.
* **Design Craft Integration:** Apply design thinking and product sense to program design—understanding user needs, designing operational experiences, and iterating based on feedback. Build systems that empower designers and product managers to do their best work while balancing flexibility with consistency, creative exploration with scalable patterns, and craft excellence with business impact.

**About You**

This is an opportunity for a driven, collaborative professional who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and contributing to projects that directly impact healthcare environments and patient care.

Located in New York, NY, on a hybrid basis.

**The Opportunity**

At Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D), we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and play. B&D partners with institutions, municipalities, and organizations to shape and deliver complex real estate and capital projects, providing strategic insight and end-to-end advisory services across the full project lifecycle.

B&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors, bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services. Together, the combined firm offers expanded capabilities across industries and throughout the full project lifecycle—from early-stage strategy and planning through execution and beyond.

Our healthcare project management team partners with clients to guide complex projects through planning, design, construction, and occupancy. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being highly engaged with clients and project teams, thrives in fast-moving environments, and wants to continue developing professionally while taking on meaningful responsibility.

As an Assistant Project Manager, you will support healthcare projects from pre-construction through closeout, collaborating closely with senior project leaders, clients, architects, engineers, consultants, and contractors to ensure successful project execution.

**How You’ll Contribute**

* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of healthcare design and construction projects across multiple phases
* Assist with project-specific tasks to help meet client goals, schedules, budgets, and contractual obligations
* Support pre-construction planning activities, conceptual design analysis, and project documentation efforts
* Coordinate and review architectural and engineering drawings, bid documents, and consultant deliverables
* Assist with contract administration activities and support the preparation of contracts, addenda, and project documentation
* Help manage permitting coordination and support project teams through regulatory approval processes
* Participate in meetings with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, and consultants to review project progress and resolve issues
* Maintain project tracking logs, open item lists, schedules, and budget documentation
* Monitor project budgets and schedules, including maintaining web-based project controls and reporting tools
* Observe construction progress and document field conditions, project updates, and safety-related observations

**Job Description: ASP Program Manager**

***Fluke Health Solutions*** *· Fluke Biomedical Division · Authorized Service Provider (ASP) Program*

***Reports to:*** *Global Service Sales Leader · Department: Global Service Sales*

**Job Summary:**

The ASP Program Manager owns the day-to-day health, growth, and performance governance of Fluke Health Solutions' global network of Authorized Service Providers (ASPs) — the third-party partners who deliver calibration, repair, and preventive maintenance service on Fluke Biomedical equipment outside of Fluke's direct service footprint.

This role is responsible for the full partner lifecycle: identifying and prioritizing new markets, qualifying and onboarding new ASPs, managing royalty and product-tier authorization structures, and running the ongoing quarterly/annual performance cadence that keeps the existing network reliable, compliant, and financially sound. The role blends program management, partner relationship management, and data-driven decision-making, and is measured on ASP network revenue growth, service quality/SLA compliance, and royalty revenue integrity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the ASP performance assessment cadence (quarterly, annual, and trigger-based) as defined in the ASP Assessment Standard Work

* Evaluate and prioritize new ASP markets using country-level revenue/opportunity modeling (install base, net incremental revenue, cannibalization risk)

* Score and qualify new ASP candidates against the standard qualification scorecard and Phase 1 audit checklist

* Manage royalty structure selection and reconciliation across the existing ASP portfolio

* Own product tier authorization decisions (which service categories each ASP is certified to perform) and reassess at each quarterly review

* Monitor SLA/turnaround-time performance and loaner pool health across all Tier 2/3 escalations

* Maintain and report on the ASP KPI dashboard (service volume, revenue vs. plan, customer satisfaction, certification status)

* Lead or coordinate process-improvement initiatives affecting the ASP network (e.g., contract renewal process, onboarding workflow)

* Serve as the primary relationship owner for escalated ASP or end-customer issues involving ASP-delivered service

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

* 3-5+ years of experience in channel/partner management, service operations, or program management — medical device, biomedical, or technical equipment industry strongly preferred

* Demonstrated experience managing partner performance against SLAs, KPIs, or contractual scorecards

**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Why this role is on the menu**
--------------------------------

We're hiring an Account Manager II to make Instacart Ads the place CPG advertisers and agencies trust to grow their business, by improving campaign performance, widening how brands invest across our ad products, and shaping the advertiser experience. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy and campaign performance, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to advertiser growth and retention. Twelve months from now, the advertisers you partner with should see Instacart as a growth partner whose recommendations they act on.

**What you'll cook up in your first year**
------------------------------------------

* Advertiser Relationships: CPG clients and agency partners treat you as a trusted advisor. Working with Sales, you understand their business objectives and build strategies that support their long-term growth on Instacart.
* Campaign Performance: Each advertiser has a full-funnel media strategy tied to its goals. You use campaign data and marketplace insights to recommend investment and optimization approaches that measurably improve results, and you manage gap-to-goal across multiple business units.
* Advertiser Growth: Advertisers adopt your optimization and upsell recommendations and expand their use of Instacart advertising products. You get there by explaining clearly how each product works, building persuasive narratives, and handling objections with confidence across multiple stakeholders.
* Business Reviews: Recurring client conversations and quarterly business reviews turn campaign data into a clear story of business impact, opportunities, and next steps. You own the vision and content for these reviews, and advertisers leave knowing what to do next. You also resolve campaign and partner issues with limited guidance.
* Product and Team Influence: Advertiser pain points reach the right internal teams as specific feedback that shapes product enhancements and process improvements. You also share best practices across the category and Advertiser Success teams and lead projects that strengthen team-wide capabilities.

  

**The secret ingredients we're looking for**
--------------------------------------------

You are customer-focused and analytical, comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, and energized by a fast-paced role where priorities and solutions keep evolving. You use judgment and initiative to balance immediate client needs against longer-term chances to improve products, processes, and advertiser outcomes, and you are at your best explaining complex campaign data in plain terms.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, changing environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting confidently to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders

* Experience with Salesforce and Tableau; familiarity with Mode is a plus
* Knowledge of paid search, display advertising, ad serving, consumer packaged goods, or ecommerce, and experience developing full-funnel media strategies and optimizing campaigns against performance goals
* Experience managing business reviews, quota-related planning, upsell opportunities, or growth strategies across multiple business units
* Strong attention to detail and organization, creative problem solving, and experience influencing product or operational improvements by synthesizing customer feedback and business insights
