For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

Our Commercial Lines team is currently seeking a **Senior Business Analyst** in our Worcester, MA location. Position is eligible for Hybrid/Flex work arrangement or remote location. This is a full-time, exempt role.

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

Incumbents serving in the Business Analysis job family are responsible for the collection, development, analysis, documentation, and communication of business needs and requirements. Throughout an assignment, Business Analysts may act like a liaison while they interface and work collaboratively with technology and business organizations. Business Analysts usually assess the needs of the assignment by directly interacting with management, leadership, technology, the business and the customer. Business Analysts are also expected to use their working understanding of information systems, business operations, and processes to analyze requirements, develop specifications, story-boarding and prototyping to facilitate the design of integrated solutions. Their knowledge of business analysis, business processes and project methodologies is applied to all of their assignments. Incumbents in this job family must have a solid understanding of their business partners existing business processes, the key drivers and measures of success for the business, and the short and long-term direction of the business and technology. They assess the needs of a business partner through direct interaction, and look for opportunities to develop and grow the business through effective use of technology. They take a broad perspective to determine how solutions will impact existing work processes and systems, and how to manage the integration. Incumbents must be innovative in identifying, proposing and executing solutions, negotiating requirements across multiple partners or departments, and must have an understanding of project scope management and prototyping. Business Analysts should have a high-level understanding of the overall IT architecture in order to understand the issues and implications of proposed system and hardware solutions.

* Performs work across multiple initiatives and processes.

jobs.title: Solutions & Sales Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

The Solutions & Sales Enablement Specialist is responsible for achieving sales and profitability targets by designing, delivering, and supporting workflow, print management, and content management solutions for Channel partners and their customers. This hybrid role integrates technical solution expertise, channel sales support, marketing enablement, and Salesforce pipeline management to strengthen partner performance and drive Fujifilm Business Innovation (FB) commercial growth.

The Specialist serves as a technical consultant, sales trainer, and enablement resource—ensuring partners have the right solutions, tools, content, and insights to compete effectively and deliver superior customer outcomes.

  
Company Overview:

At FUJIFILM North America Corporation, we are many things to both consumers and business customers. We’re looking for passionate, mission-driven people to help us continue to innovate.

  

With five operating divisions, there’s a lot of opportunity to find your niche and make an impact. Perhaps you’ll click with our Imaging Division that provides one-time-use cameras, digital printing equipment, and instax™. Maybe you’ll get charged up about our Electronic Imaging Division that markets digital cameras, lenses, and accessories for content creators. Or, you might have your eye on our Optical Devices Division, which provides optical lenses for the broadcast, cinematography, videography, and industrial markets. You could be drawn to our Business Innovation Division—they develop office and commercial print solutions and enable digital transformation. And if you’re interested in tape, check out our Industrial Products Division—they develop data storage solutions.

  

The Business Innovation Division of FUJIFILM North America Corporation is the largest graphic distributor in the US. We deliver world-class state-of-the-art solutions for Digital Printing, Production Toner Solutions, Office A3/A4 MFP Products, Packaging, and a full range of traditional Offset printing products. In addition, we are the industry leader in Color Standardization and G7 implementation.

  

We offer a collegial culture and a flexible work environment. Our headquarters is in Valhalla, New York, a quaint town just one hour north of New York City.

  

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description:

**Workflow & Technical Solutions Delivery**

* Design, propose, implement, and support copy/print/scan/fax and workflow solutions aligned with partner and customer requirements.
* Diagnose and resolve complex hardware, software, network, and cloud-related issues.
* Collaborate with FNAC Channel Sales, Technical Specialists, and 3rd party vendors to deliver best practice solutions.
* Conduct solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and technical evaluations for partner opportunities.
* Provide technical product and solution training to partner sales teams and internal stakeholders.
* Support special projects introducing new technologies and solutions to the U.S. market.
* Maintain deep knowledge of MFP/Printer hardware, operating systems, cloud environments, Windows server/desktop, and network technologies.

**Sales Enablement & Marketing Support**

* Develop and deliver sales enablement materials including solution briefs, competitive battlecards, demo scripts, partner playbooks, and training modules.
* Partner with Marketing to align messaging, campaigns, and product positioning with channel needs.
* Support partner-facing events, roadshows, webinars, and joint sales calls.
* Create and maintain solution-focused assets for partner onboarding and continuous education.
* Identify market trends, customer pain points, and competitive threats to inform GTM strategy.
* Provide feedback to Global Operations Marketing to ensure U.S. market needs are represented in product and solution planning.

**Salesforce & Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate Salesforce reporting including call reports, partner visits, events, business plans, training sessions, pipeline updates, and forecasting.
* Build dashboards and insights that help leadership and partners make data-driven decisions.
* Ensure partner opportunities are properly qualified, tracked, and advanced through the sales cycle.
* Analyze pipeline trends to identify growth opportunities, risks, and enablement gaps.
* Support adoption of CRM best practices across channel partners and internal teams.

**Channel Partner Engagement**

* Conduct a minimum of three partner-facing meetings per day (on-site/off-site), including sales calls, training, marketing events, and solution troubleshooting.
* Strengthen partner relationships through proactive communication, technical guidance, and joint business planning.
* Manage vendor relationships to ensure optimal solution performance and partner satisfaction.
* Advise partners on technology selection aligned with customer requirements and competitive dynamics.
* Collaborate with FNAC teams to resolve complex issues involving process, software, hardware, or workflow design.

**Continuous Improvement & Professional Development**

* Identify areas for process improvement and recommend methods for implementing enhancements.
* Investigate and implement new support processes for print-related solutions.
* Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings.
* Pursue ongoing self-development through training, certifications, and skill-building opportunities.
* Actively contribute to Solutions Services team goals and cross-functional initiatives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Achievement of revenue, gross profit, and unit sales targets.
* Quarterly attainment of key sales KPIs per territory.
* Increase

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner** to drive business requirements, product vision, stakeholder collaboration, and end-to-end delivery of software solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **business analysis, Product Ownership, requirements management, functional testing, regression testing, UAT, and test case development**.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, developers, QA teams, and project leadership to translate business needs into clear functional requirements and ensure solutions meet business and user expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* Serve as a **Product Owner / Senior Business Analyst**, representing business and user needs throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Define and maintain **product vision, roadmap, priorities, and backlog** in collaboration with stakeholders and technical teams.
* Gather, analyze, document, and validate **business and functional requirements**.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, requirements workshops, process analysis, and gap analysis.
* Create detailed **Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and use cases**.
* Translate business requirements into actionable user stories and clearly defined acceptance criteria for development and QA teams.
* Prioritize product backlog based on business value, customer needs, dependencies, and project objectives.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, QA engineers, and business stakeholders throughout the SDLC.
* Participate in **Agile/Scrum ceremonies**, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Develop and execute **functional test cases and test scenarios** based on business and functional requirements.
* Perform **functional testing** to validate application functionality against approved requirements.
* Perform **regression testing** following application enhancements, bug fixes, and new releases.
* Support and coordinate **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** with business users and stakeholders.
* Create UAT plans, test scenarios, test cases, and expected results.
* Coordinate UAT execution, track defects, validate fixes, and obtain business sign-off.
* Review test results and ensure identified defects are properly documented, prioritized, and resolved.
* Perform **requirements traceability** to ensure business requirements are covered by development and testing activities.
* Work closely with QA teams to ensure adequate test coverage and alignment between requirements and test cases.
* Validate completed features against **acceptance criteria** and determine whether stories are ready for production.
* Analyze production issues and support root-cause analysis and resolution.
* Facilitate communication between technical teams and business stakeholders to resolve functional and product-related issues.
* Prepare status reports, product documentation, release notes, and stakeholder communications.
* Support implementation, deployment, and post-production validation activities.

Required Skills & Experience

* **10+ years of experience** as a Business Analyst, Senior Business Analyst, Product Owner, or similar role.
* Strong experience working as a **Product Owner within Agile/Scrum environments**.
* Strong understanding of **SDLC, Agile methodologies, and software product development**.
* Hands-on experience with **requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, and management**.
* Strong experience writing **user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, BRDs, FRDs, and functional specifications**.
* Experience with **functional testing, regression testing, and UAT**.
* Strong knowledge of **test case and test scenario creation and execution**.
* Experience coordinating UAT with business users and stakeholders.
* Experience with **defect management, validation, and resolution tracking**.
* Strong understanding of **requirements traceability and test coverage**.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear technical and functional specifications.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and analytical skills.
* Experience working closely with **developers, QA teams, architects, project managers, and business stakeholders**.
* Strong problem-solving and documentation skills.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid holidays
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Transportation Learning Experience Designer (LXD) / Instructional Designer
  
  
**Location:** Primarily Remote (with periodic in person meetings and training within the Raleigh, NC area)  
  
**Schedule:** Part-Time (20–25 hours per week)  
  
**About Us**  
Goins Sweitzer Engineers and Consultants (GSEC) is a multi-modal, transportation-focused consulting firm offering construction management solutions to our clients’ infrastructure project needs through the delivery of responsive, high-quality construction and engineering inspection (CEI), contract administration, construction materials management, utility coordination, training, value analysis, cost estimating, risk assessment, and specialized project and program management consulting services.  
We are committed to delivering exceptional services and creating a truly outstanding experience for both our employees and our clients. Our firm was built with the vision of fostering a work environment that inspires personal and professional growth, empowering every individual to reach their fullest potential. This employee-centric culture fosters an environment that attracts top-tier professionals who are deeply committed to delivering exceptional, high-quality services with professionalism and genuine care for our clients.  
  
**Position Summary**  
GSEC is seeking an experienced Learning & Development Specialist / Instructional Designer to support transportation owners and agencies, including state departments of transportation, local governments, and transportation authorities. This position will focus on modernizing, standardizing, and enhancing technical training programs, certification courses, engineering manuals, construction administration resources, and presentation materials used to train transportation professionals.  
  
This role is primarily remote; however, candidates must be within a 90 minutes’ drive of Raleigh, NC and have reliable transportation to attend periodic in-person meetings and collaboration sessions as needed.  
The successful candidate will work closely with engineers, construction professionals, and subject matter experts to transform technical content into engaging, learner-centered training programs that reflect current industry practices, regulatory requirements, and adult learning methodologies and strategies. This role will play a key part in creating consistency across certification and workforce development programs while improving the overall learner experience.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of modern learning science and emerging training technologies, with the ability to develop engaging content across multiple learning modalities, including instructor-led training, self-paced e-learning, microlearning, video-based instruction, interactive digital resources, and visual communication tools. The candidate shall possess strong graphic design skills and experience required to develop professional, visually engaging, and effective learning materials. This position requires the ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, well-organized visual content that enhances understanding, reinforces key concepts, and supports effective learning.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**Transportation Training Program Modernization**

* Review and update transportation-related technical manuals, certification course materials, participant guides, instructor manuals, and presentation content.
* Ensure training materials reflect current transportation industry standards, agency policies, specifications, procedures, and best practices.
* Modernize existing courses using contemporary adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies such as Bloom Taxonomy and Kirkpatrick Evaluation Model.
* Improve course organization, content flow, visual presentation, and learner engagement.
* Reimagine traditional classroom and manual-based content using modern learning formats such as microlearning modules, video tutorials, interactive exercises, scenario-based learning, and digital reference tools.
* Evaluate emerging training technologies, learning trends, and instructional approaches to continuously improve learner engagement and knowledge retention.

**Curriculum Standardization and Quality Improvement**

* Establish standardized formats, templates, instructional practices, and branding across all training programs.
* Develop consistent learning objectives, assessments, course structures, and instructional materials.
* Create processes for maintaining current and accurate training materials as standards, specifications, and regulations evolve.
* Support quality assurance reviews and training audits to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop visual design standards and content guidelines that create a consistent, professional, and engaging learner experience across all training products.

**Instructional Design and Content Development**

* Collaborate with transportation engineers, construction managers, inspectors, technicians, and agency representatives to develop effective training materials.
* Translate complex technical information into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences.
* Develop assessments, practical exercises, case studies, and knowledge checks that reinforce learning objectives.
* Incorporate learner, instructor, and stakeholder feedback into course revisions and enhancements.
* Design visually compelling learning materials, including infographics, process maps, diagrams, animations, job aids, and digital reference tools that simplify complex technical concepts.
* Develop and edit instructional video content, including recorded presentations, demonstrations, interviews with subject matter experts, screen-capture tutorials, and short-form learning modules.
* Apply principles of visual communication, storytelling, user experience design, and learner psychology to increase engagement, comprehension, and retentio

Temp to Perm (3 months - conversion based on performance and business need)

**JOB MISSION**

The mission of the Clinic Operations Manager at ACES is to elevate the standards in the treatment of Autism by providing administrative support to ACES’ clinical staff.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The role supports clinic operations through strategic scheduling, staff coordination, and client engagement to ensure optimal service delivery and prescription fulfillment. It involves managing Behavior Interventionist (BI) onboarding, performance, and satisfaction, while collaborating with HR and Clinical Directors to address staffing needs and retention. Additionally, the position oversees front desk duties, facility maintenance, and promotes center events to enhance client experience and operational efficiency.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

Working under the Clinical Director, essential job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* **Scheduling Support**

  + Follow established scheduling protocols and software use to manage session cancellations and rescheduling for in center clients
  + Collaborate with Clinical Directors regularly to meet prescription fulfillment
  + Coordinate assessment scheduling between assessors and new clients
* **BI Support and Management**

  + Collaborate with HR on BI-related needs (e.g., payroll, additional supports) and provide strategic input on hiring by assessing client staffing needs; participate in interviewing potential BI candidates

* **Client Supports**

  + Serve as a positive contact for in center clients and caregivers

  + Oversee daily clinic operations, including opening and closing procedures; coordinate Manager on Duty coverage in collaboration with office leadership
  + Monitor center space utilization and coordinate scheduling of physical therapy sessions and assessments to maximize efficiency and meet client needs
  + Conduct in-center tours for prospective clients, highlighting the clinic’s physical space and clinical excellence.
  + Manage front desk responsibilities including greeting staff and caregivers, answering phones, relaying messages, and ensuring proper sign-in/out procedures.
  + Manage incoming mail and packages, ensuring timely distribution and handling in accordance with center protocols
  + Promote center events by posting announcements and sending reminders to increase attendance and engagement.

The foregoing job responsibilities are illustrative only and are not meant to be exhaustive. ACES reserves the right to change, amend or modify the job description/responsibilities at any time and in its sole discretion.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum of a high school diploma
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in a professional office environment
* Previous experience in a front desk or administrative support role
* Strong background in customer service; experience in client-facing roles preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant software, including email, internet applications, databases, and project management tools
* Exceptional organizational, time management, and multitasking skills
* Maintains a professional demeanor, positive attitude, and polished appearance
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to adhere to strict protocols and maintain compliance with HIPAA regulations
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with daily deadlines
* Receptive to feedback and adaptable to changing priorities

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force and lift/move up to 15 pounds
* Ability to sit for long periods of time (up to 3 hours at a time) during the scheduled workday

new_jobs.description:
**About Optivolt**
------------------

Optivolt’s mission is to overshoot humanity’s energy supply by reimagining solar.

America is at an inflection point. We need reliable energy fast. The grid is aging. And solar, the only technology that deploys quickly enough, is still constrained by technology frozen in time.

To close this gap, we build intelligent solar systems that think and adapt to real world conditions. Optivolt solar systems understand the sun, the weather, shading, harsh conditions, and optimize energy flow in real time. Every Optivolt panel is designed with an aerospace power electronics brain sealed inside to make solar more powerful and cost effective than ever in any condition.

The next step is putting it everywhere. In the home as Optivolt Home Solar and in the field as Optivolt Solar Fields. Hyper performant, controllable, reliable solar that works for everyone, everywhere.

**Our Team & Traction**
-----------------------

Optivolt is a team of some of the best builders and doers in the world, drawing from incredible talent pools in aerospace, electrical engineering, design-led organizations. We ultimately will win by designing and building the world’s best solar energy products.

### **2. Accounting and ERP Systems**

* Administer and improve ERP and accounting workflows across purchasing, inventory, billing, and reporting; maintain accurate records and access controls.

### **3. Contracts and Business Administration**

* Coordinate customer and vendor agreements, NDAs, and purchase terms from preparation through approval and signature.
* Negotiate commercial terms with leadership and coordinate legal review with counsel; track open issues through completion.
* Maintain contract, insurance, and corporate records; track renewals, obligations, and administrative deadlines.

### **4. Shipping Logistics and Inventory**

* Own domestic and international shipping and receiving for prototypes, equipment, production materials, and field deployments.
* Manage carriers, freight forwarders, rates, shipping and customs documentation, delivery tracking, and claims or exceptions.
* Maintain inventory accuracy through labeling, cycle counts, and ERP reconciliation; coordinate returns and RMAs with engineering and quality.

### **5. Facilities and Lab Operations**

* Manage facility vendors, service contracts, budgets, upgrades, and equipment installations to support engineering and production needs.
* Provide hands-on support for deliveries, visitors, workspace changes, and indoor and outdoor test setups.

* Hands-on experience managing working capital and preparing cash-flow forecasts, budgets, financial projections, and variance analyses.
* Working knowledge of bookkeeping, AR/AP, account reconciliations, and financial statements; experience supporting an accounting close.
* Experience administering or improving ERP and accounting systems across purchasing, inventory, and finance.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial models, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and scenario analysis.
* Experience coordinating contracts, negotiating commercial terms, and working with legal counsel or external advisors.
* Experience managing facilities, logistics, vendors, and physical inventory in a hardware, manufacturing, lab, or similar environment.
* Ability to prioritize independently, communicate financial and operational tradeoffs, and handle confidential information responsibly.
* Track record improving processes and controls while remaining willing to handle routine accounting,

**POSITION SUMMARY**  
The Project Manager, Proteostasis Project, supports the Buck Institute's leadership of a multi-participant project focused on proteostasis. Reporting into Technology Transfer & Business Development, this role works closely with the Buck lead Principal Investigator and scientists to manage Buck's internal and external obligations under the agreements.  
  
The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating project reporting, identifying and reporting inventions, coordinating compliance, preparing meetings and presentations, and serving as the day-to-day liaison between Buck and Project Team Members. The role is scientist-facing and team oriented. It does not process payments or execute agreements; those functions remain with Finance, Grants and the Institute's authorized signatories, whom this position supports with documentation and tracking.

* Serve as the day-to-day administrative point of contact with the funding representative and the broader project team in coordination with the Buck PI and Business Development.

* Issue reporting and deliverable templates communicate deadlines and any changing requirements, and enforce internal deadlines.
* Proactively identify late, incomplete, or at-risk contributions and work with the responsible team member, collaborating institution, and project leadership to resolve issues.
* Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar of every obligation, deliverable, milestone and reporting deadline under all the agreements supporting the project from kickoff through close-out.
* Maintain the consolidated project file on behalf of the Buck and make it available to co-lead university collaborator.

* Arrange agendas, briefing materials and presentations for team and funder encounters, including the program kickoff, monthly progress meetings, milestone reviews, annual PI review meetings and funder site visits.

* Track joint inventions and assist with the negotiation, execution and maintenance of inter-institutional agreements.

**Compliance and Program Requirements**

* Collect annual certifications as required.

**Job Title:** Care Navigator  
**Job Location:** Remote with possibility of going into wellness center in Victorville, CA

**Company Description:**  
Greater Good Health is a community of healthcare providers, operators, and builders whose mission is to address health disparities and reimagine senior healthcare. To do this, we partner with payers to bring value-based primary care to underserved communities and work alongside risk-bearing organizations to develop innovative, value-based clinical programs– all designed exclusively for older adults and their unique healthcare needs. Grounded in our mission and core values, we are building a better, simpler healthcare experience for the patients we serve and the providers who care for them.  
  
While providing more access to care, we understand that Nurse Practitioners need optimal work-life alignment to provide the best care for the greater good. GGH’s goal is to support the modern-day healthcare professional to live fully in both their

professional and personal lives.  
  
If this vision resonates with you, we hope you consider bringing your passion, your energy, your curiosity to Greater Good Health.

**The Role**

The GGH Care Navigator plays a critical role as the primary point of contact for engaging patients, coordinating their care across settings, and connecting them to the right resources at the right time. Successful Care Navigators are excellent communicators, empathetic, and have a strong work ethic and desire to positively impact the quality of care delivered by GGH. They are welcoming and courteous, possess superior active listening and critical thinking skills, and are comfortable with multitasking and problem-solving. Care Navigators serve as patient advocates — removing barriers to care, supporting patients through complex health journeys, and ensuring that no patient falls through the cracks. They must also be skilled at relating to the geriatric population, building trust, and making patients feel supported at every step of their healthcare experience.  
  
**Applicants must be comfortable working 8a–5p (PST).**  
  
**Typical Duties**  
**Patient Outreach & Engagement**

* Conduct proactive outreach to schedule patient home, telehealth, and in-clinic visits to complete Annual Wellness Visits (AWVs), ensuring patients receive timely preventative care and individualized care plans.
* Accept inbound calls from patients to schedule AWVs and address care-related questions or concerns.
* Connect with the geriatric population to build trusting, long-term relationships — making patients feel calm, comfortable, and heard throughout their care experience.
* Identify and address barriers to engagement, including transportation, language, health literacy, financial hardship, and other social and environmental factors.
* Outreach to patients to complete key preventative screenings (colon cancer, mammograms, diabetic retina scans, HbA1c, and more), documenting outreach and establishing follow-through plans.

**Care Coordination & Panel Management**

* Manage patients post-discharge from hospital or skilled nursing facility settings, coordinating timely follow-up visits and facilitating care plan transitions to reduce readmission risk.
* Follow up with patients on outstanding provider orders — including lab work, imaging, specialist referrals, and durable medical equipment — ensuring completion and routing results back to the care team.
* Coordinate referrals and activities for high-risk programs, facilitating smooth transitions between care settings and service providers.
* Support the care team in identifying and closing quality gaps, including HEDIS measures and chronic disease management needs.

**Compliance & Documentation**

* Handle protected health information (PHI) with discretion, adhering to HIPAA standards and GGH privacy policies at all times.
* Maintain timely, accurate, and thorough documentation of all patient interactions, outreach attempts, care coordination activities, and follow-up plans.

**Collaboration & Program Development**

* Build strong, positive working relationships with GGH Nurse Practitioners and the Patient Outreach Team, and maintain professional communications with client partners and the broader care team.
* Participate in interdisciplinary care team meetings, contributing patient updates and coordinating action steps across team members.
* Maintain collaborative relationships with clinicians and the leadership team to support the development of new programs aimed at improving patient engagement, care coordination, and health outcomes.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Key Success Outcomes**

Absolute Security is the enterprise cyber resilience leader. Our patented Persistence technology is embedded in the firmware of more than 600 million devices through partnerships with nearly 30 of the world’s leading device manufacturers, giving us an unbreakable, self-healing connection to the endpoint that no other vendor can match. Built on that foundation, the Absolute Security Cyber Resilience Platform unifies Secure Endpoint and Secure Access (SSE/ZTNA) so customers stay operational through disruption, recover faster from ransomware and outages, and maintain continuous device trust even when controls are removed or compromised.  
  
We are trusted by thousands of global enterprises and licensed across 16 million devices. With roots in North America and backing from Crosspoint Capital Partners, we are investing in the carrier and telco partnerships that put cyber resilience in the hands of every mobile and hybrid workforce.

We are hiring a **Channel Account Manager** to own and grow a portfolio of carrier and telco partnerships, anchored by AT&T, with a mandate to identify and onboard additional strategic partners over time. This is a senior, individual contributor role responsible for turning these relationships into a scaled, repeatable, partner-sourced revenue engine, attaching Absolute’s firmware-embedded resilience and Secure Access to each partner’s enterprise mobility, managed device, and connectivity offerings.  
  
You will operate at the intersection of multiple organizations: building executive and field-level relationships inside each partner, aligning their go-to-market motions with ours, and orchestrating the internal Absolute resources: sales, product, marketing, and enablement needed to win together. Success looks like partner teams that know when and how to lead with Absolute, joint business plans that are actively executed, and a joint pipeline that grows quarter over quarter.

**Location:** **North America — Remote (Dallas/Austin or SF Bay Area preferred)**

**What You’ll Do**  
*Strategic account planning*

* Build and own a joint business plan for each anchor partner: value proposition, target segments, routes to market (co-sell, embed, and managed-service attach), and a measurable growth path and maintain it through a regular QBR cadence with both partner and internal stakeholders.
* Prioritize and sequence investment across the portfolio so the highest-return partnerships get the focus, and “potential” partners are qualified before they consume resources.

*Revenue*

* Carry and exceed new and expansion ARR targets across the partner portfolio, with accurate forecasting and a clear quarter-by-quarter path.
* Use partner and pipeline data to prove the unit economics of each relationship to leadership on both sides and to remove friction in joint selling.

*Enablement*

* Build and drive partner enablement, train and certify partner sellers and SEs, equip them with joint solution messaging and tools, and ensure each partner can position and sell Absolute without hand-holding.
* Partner with Absolute marketing to deliver demand-generation programs and assets that partners can take to market.

*Relationships and alignment*

* Build executive sponsorship and seller-level mindshare across each partner, elevating Absolute from a line item to a strategic component of their security and mobility portfolio.
* Align tightly with Absolute’s regional field sales and broader alliances team so partner-led and direct motions reinforce rather than collide.
* Embed Absolute into the partner offerings and plays where our firmware-resilience and Secure Access portfolio creates the most differentiated value.
* Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers.
* Other duties as assigned by management

**What You’ll Bring:**

* 5+ years in technology sales, channel, or strategic alliances, with a proven record of exceeding new and expansion revenue targets in a quota-carrying role.

new_jobs.description:
Position Overview:

The Solutions & Sales Enablement Specialist is responsible for achieving sales and profitability targets by designing, delivering, and supporting workflow, print management, and content management solutions for Channel partners and their customers. This hybrid role integrates technical solution expertise, channel sales support, marketing enablement, and Salesforce pipeline management to strengthen partner performance and drive Fujifilm Business Innovation (FB) commercial growth.

The Specialist serves as a technical consultant, sales trainer, and enablement resource—ensuring partners have the right solutions, tools, content, and insights to compete effectively and deliver superior customer outcomes.

  
Company Overview:

At FUJIFILM North America Corporation, we are many things to both consumers and business customers. We’re looking for passionate, mission-driven people to help us continue to innovate.

  

With five operating divisions, there’s a lot of opportunity to find your niche and make an impact. Perhaps you’ll click with our Imaging Division that provides one-time-use cameras, digital printing equipment, and instax™. Maybe you’ll get charged up about our Electronic Imaging Division that markets digital cameras, lenses, and accessories for content creators. Or, you might have your eye on our Optical Devices Division, which provides optical lenses for the broadcast, cinematography, videography, and industrial markets. You could be drawn to our Business Innovation Division—they develop office and commercial print solutions and enable digital transformation. And if you’re interested in tape, check out our Industrial Products Division—they develop data storage solutions.

  

The Business Innovation Division of FUJIFILM North America Corporation is the largest graphic distributor in the US. We deliver world-class state-of-the-art solutions for Digital Printing, Production Toner Solutions, Office A3/A4 MFP Products, Packaging, and a full range of traditional Offset printing products. In addition, we are the industry leader in Color Standardization and G7 implementation.

  

We offer a collegial culture and a flexible work environment. Our headquarters is in Valhalla, New York, a quaint town just one hour north of New York City.

  

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers
